decisions.reason: John ranks himself below a slave beside the one who is coming (m2); a Japanese speaker saying that would naturally speak of him with respect. This is John's own register, as in John 1:26-27, not the narrator's honorific. He speaks to the crowds in the plain style.

decisions.choice: Plain "او", "کفش‌هایش" for the one coming; no plural of respect
decisions.reason: Persian could honour the one coming with the plural "ایشان", as the Hindi does with "वे", but the style guide (section 5) never uses ایشان for one person, and God and Jesus are spoken of as "او" throughout. Respect is carried by what John says about him.

decisions.choice: "لست أهلًا" (L), "لا أستحقّ" (B, R); "سير حذائه" (L), "رباط حذائه" (B)
decisions.reason: Untying a master's sandal was a slave's task (m2). "حذاء" is the plain word for footwear; "سير" is the strap of Literal, "رباط" the tie of Balanced.

decisions.choice: Honorific "ਆ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ", "ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ" for the one coming
decisions.reason: John speaks of the Messiah.

source.text: ἐγὼ ἐβάπτισα ὑμᾶς ὕδατι, αὐτὸς δὲ βαπτίσει ὑμᾶς ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: I baptized you with water, he but will baptize you in [the] Spirit Holy.

en.L: I baptized you with water, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will baptize you in [the] Holy Spirit."
en.B: The baptism I gave you was with water; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."
en.R: I used water when I baptized you. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."

vi.L: Tôi đã làm báp-têm cho các người bằng nước, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người trong Đức Thánh Linh."
vi.B: Tôi làm báp-têm cho các người bằng nước, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người bằng Đức Thánh Linh."
vi.R: Tôi dùng nước để làm báp-têm cho các người. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ làm báp-têm cho các người bằng Đức Thánh Linh."

ko.L: 나는 너희에게 물로 세례를 주었지만, 그분은 너희에게 성령으로 세례를 주실 것이다."
ko.B: 나는 너희에게 물로 세례를 주었다. 그러나 그분은 성령으로 너희에게 세례를 주실 것이다."
ko.R: 나는 너희에게 세례를 줄 때 물을 썼다. 그러나 그분은 성령으로 너희에게 세례를 주실 것이다."

es.L: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} bauticé con agua, pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará en [el] Espíritu Santo».
es.B: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} he bautizado con agua, pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará con el Espíritu Santo».
es.R: Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} bauticé con agua. Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} bautizará con el Espíritu Santo».

fr.L: Moi, je vous ai baptisés d’eau, mais {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous baptisera dans [l’]Esprit Saint. »
fr.B: Moi, je vous ai baptisés avec de l’eau ; {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vous baptisera avec l’Esprit Saint. »
fr.R: Moi, je vous ai baptisés avec de l’eau. Mais {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous baptisera avec l’Esprit Saint. »

sw.L: Mimi niliwabatiza kwa maji, lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atawabatiza katika Roho Mtakatifu."
sw.B: Ubatizo niliowapa ulikuwa wa maji; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu."
sw.R: Mimi nilitumia maji nilipowabatiza. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atawabatiza kwa Roho Mtakatifu."

pt.L: Eu os batizei com água, mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os batizará no Espírito Santo."
pt.B: O batismo que eu dei a vocês foi com água; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os batizará com o Espírito Santo."
pt.R: Eu usei água quando batizei vocês. Mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai batizar vocês com o Espírito Santo."

am.B: እኔ ያጠመቅኳችሁ በውኃ ነው፤ እርሱ ግን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ያጠምቃችኋል።»
am.R: እኔ ስጠምቃችሁ የተጠቀምኩት ውኃን ነው። እርሱ ግን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ያጠምቃችኋል።»

ru.L: Я крестил вас водой, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} же будет крестить вас в Святом Духе.»

hi.L: मैंने तुम्हें पानी से बपतिस्मा दिया है, पर वे तुम्हें पवित्र आत्मा में बपतिस्मा देंगे।"
hi.B: मैंने तुम्हें पानी से बपतिस्मा दिया है, पर वे तुम्हें पवित्र आत्मा से बपतिस्मा देंगे।"

uk.L: Я хрестив вас водою, а {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} хреститиме вас у Святому Дусі.»
uk.B: Я хрестив вас водою, а {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} хреститиме вас Святим Духом.»
uk.R: Я хрестив вас водою. А {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} хреститиме вас Святим Духом.»

ja.L: わたしはあなたがたに水で洗礼を授けた。しかしその方は、聖霊においてあなたがたに洗礼を授けられる。」
ja.B: わたしは水であなたがたに洗礼を授けたが、その方は聖霊であなたがたに洗礼を授けられる。」
ja.R: わたしは水を使って、あなたたちに洗礼を授けた。しかしその方は、聖霊であなたたちに洗礼を授けられる。」

id.L: Aku membaptis kalian dengan air, tetapi {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} akan membaptis kalian dalam Roh Kudus."
id.B: Aku membaptis kalian dengan air; {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} akan membaptis kalian dengan Roh Kudus."
id.R: Aku memakai air ketika membaptis kalian. Tetapi {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} akan membaptis kalian dengan Roh Kudus."

zh.L: 我曾用水给你们施洗，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}却要在圣灵中给你们施洗。”
zh.B: 我给你们施的洗是用水；{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}却要用圣灵为你们施洗。”
zh.R: 我是用水为你们施洗。但是{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}要用圣灵为你们施洗。”

fa.L: من شما را با آب تعمید دادم، اما او شما را در روح‌القدس تعمید خواهد داد.»
fa.B: تعمیدی که من به شما دادم با آب بود؛ او شما را با روح‌القدس تعمید خواهد داد.»
fa.R: من وقتی شما را تعمید دادم از آب استفاده کردم. اما او شما را با روح‌القدس تعمید خواهد داد.»

ar.L: أنا عمّدتكم بالماء، أمّا هو فسيعمّدكم في الروح القدس».
ar.B: المعمودية التي أعطيتكم إيّاها كانت بالماء، أمّا هو فسيعمّدكم بالروح القدس».
ar.R: أنا عمّدتكم بالماء، لكنّه هو سيعمّدكم بالروح القدس».

pa.L: ਮੈਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ, ਪਰ ਉਹ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਆਤਮਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਦੇਣਗੇ।"
pa.B: ਜਿਹੜਾ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਉਹ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਲ ਸੀ; ਉਹ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਆਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਦੇਣਗੇ।"
pa.R: ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਦੇਣ ਲਈ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਰਤਿਆ। ਪਰ ਉਹ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਆਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਦੇਣਗੇ।"

decisions.choice: I baptized: John looks at the work he has done
decisions.reason: The verb is past. John speaks of his baptism as done, set against what the coming one will do.

decisions.choice: baptize with the Holy Spirit: pour out God's Spirit on people
decisions.reason: The prophets promised that God would pour out his Spirit on his people (Joel 2:28; Ezekiel 36:26-27). The one who is coming will do what water only pictures.

decisions.choice: in the Spirit: the Spirit is what people will be plunged into
alternatives: by the Spirit, as the one who acts
decisions.reason: Water and the Spirit stand side by side as the element of each baptism.

decisions.choice: with water, in the Holy Spirit (L); with ... with (B, R)
alternatives: in water, in the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: The Greek has no preposition with "water" and "in" with "Spirit". Literal keeps the difference. Balanced and Readable say "with" for both, the natural English.

decisions.choice: John speaks to the crowds as "các người"
decisions.reason: A prophet addressing the whole crowd, men and women, speaks as the style guide has Jesus speak to crowds; "các ông" (used to the envoys in John 1:19-27) would address only men.

decisions.choice: "물로" and "성령으로" at every level
decisions.reason: Korean "-로 세례를 주다" covers both "with" and "in", as in John 1:26 and 1:33; "성령 안에서" would sound as if the Spirit were the place where the baptizer stands. The English Literal's "in" has no natural Korean counterpart; the meaning decision explains the picture of being plunged into the Spirit.

decisions.choice: dans [l’]Esprit Saint
decisions.reason: The Greek has no article and French cannot leave it out, so Literal brackets it, as in John 1:33. "Moi ... lui, il" shows the emphatic pronouns of the Greek.

decisions.choice: "አጠመቅኳችሁ" (I baptized you), past tense
decisions.reason: Mark's verb looks back on the work John has done, where Matthew's is present, so the Amharic differs from the Matthew parallel here.

decisions.choice: 'водой ... в Святом Духе' (L); 'водой ... Святым Духом' (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has a bare case with 'water' and 'in' with 'Spirit'. Literal keeps the difference; Balanced and Readable use the instrumental for both, the natural Russian.

decisions.choice: "पानी से", "पवित्र आत्मा में" (L); "से" for both (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here the Greek has no preposition with "water" (Matthew 3:11 has "in"), and "in" with "Spirit". Literal keeps the difference with "से" and "में"; Balanced and Readable say "से" for both, as Hindi speaks of baptism.

decisions.choice: "用水", "在圣灵中" (L); "用水", "用圣灵" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark has no preposition with "water" and "in" with "Spirit" (Matthew 3:11 has "in" with both). Literal keeps the difference; Balanced and Readable say "用" for both.

decisions.choice: "با آب", "در روح‌القدس" (Literal); "با" for both (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek's two prepositions apart, as the English Literal does (with water, in the Holy Spirit); the other levels say "با" for both, which is how Persian speaks of baptizing.

decisions.choice: "بالماء ... في الروح القدس" (L); "بالماء ... بالروح القدس" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the change of preposition in the Greek, "in the Spirit", the element people are plunged into (m3); Balanced and Readable say "بـ" for both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾਲ", "ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਆਤਮਾ ਵਿੱਚ" (L); "ਨਾਲ" for both (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has a plain dative, then en.

source.text: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲτ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη εἰς τὸν Ἰορδάνην ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου.

records.literal_gloss: And it came to pass in those the days came Jesus from Nazareth of the Galilee and was baptized into the Jordan by John.

en.L: And it happened in those days [that] Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee and was baptized into the Jordan by John.
en.B: It was during those days that Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and John baptized {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the Jordan.
en.R: During that time, Jesus came from the town of Nazareth in the land of Galilee. John baptized {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in the Jordan River.

vi.L: Và xảy ra trong những ngày ấy, Đức Giê-xu từ Na-xa-rét thuộc Ga-li-lê đến và được Giăng làm báp-têm trong sông Giô-đanh.
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, Đức Giê-xu từ Na-xa-rét, xứ Ga-li-lê, đến và được Giăng làm báp-têm dưới sông Giô-đanh.
vi.R: Trong thời gian đó, Đức Giê-xu từ làng Na-xa-rét ở miền Ga-li-lê đến. Giăng làm báp-têm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dưới sông Giô-đanh.

ko.L: 그리고 그 날들에 [이런] 일이 있었다. 예수께서 갈릴리의 나사렛에서 오셔서, 요단강에 [들어가] 요한에게 세례를 받으셨다.
ko.B: 그 무렵에 예수께서 갈릴리 나사렛에서 오셔서 요단강에서 요한에게 세례를 받으셨다.
ko.R: 그때 예수께서 갈릴리 지방의 나사렛 마을에서 오셨다. 그리고 요단강에서 요한에게 세례를 받으셨다.

es.L: Y sucedió en aquellos días [que] vino Jesús desde Nazaret de Galilea y fue bautizado en el Jordán por Juan.
es.B: Por aquellos días, Jesús llegó desde Nazaret, en Galilea, y Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} bautizó en el Jordán.
es.R: En ese tiempo, Jesús vino desde el pueblo de Nazaret, en la región de Galilea. Juan {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} bautizó en el río Jordán.

fr.L: Et il arriva en ces jours-là [que] Jésus vint de Nazareth de Galilée et fut baptisé dans le Jourdain par Jean.
fr.B: En ces jours-là, Jésus vint de Nazareth, en Galilée, et Jean {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} baptisa dans le Jourdain.
fr.R: À cette époque, Jésus est venu de Nazareth, un village de Galilée. Jean {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a baptisé dans le Jourdain.

sw.L: Na ikawa katika siku zile Yesu alikuja kutoka Nazareti ya Galilaya, akabatizwa ndani ya Yordani na Yohana.
sw.B: Ilikuwa katika siku hizo ambapo Yesu alikuja kutoka Nazareti ya Galilaya, naye Yohana akambatiza katika Yordani.
sw.R: Wakati huo Yesu alikuja kutoka mji wa Nazareti katika nchi ya Galilaya. Yohana akambatiza katika Mto Yordani.

pt.L: E aconteceu, naqueles dias, [que] Jesus veio de Nazaré da Galileia e foi batizado no Jordão por João.
pt.B: Foi nesses dias que Jesus veio de Nazaré, na Galileia, e João {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} batizou no Jordão.
pt.R: Nesse tempo, Jesus veio do povoado de Nazaré, na região da Galileia. João {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} batizou no rio Jordão.

am.L: በዚያም ወራት እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ኢየሱስ ከገሊላ ናዝሬት መጣ፤ ወደ ዮርዳኖስም [ገብቶ] በዮሐንስ ተጠመቀ።
am.B: በዚያ ወራት ኢየሱስ ከገሊላ ናዝሬት መጣ፤ ዮሐንስም በዮርዳኖስ አጠመቀው።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በገሊላ ምድር ካለችው ከናዝሬት ከተማ መጣ። ዮሐንስም በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ አጠመቀው።

ru.L: И было в те дни: пришёл Иисус из Назарета Галилейского и был крещён Иоанном в Иордане.
ru.B: В те дни Иисус пришёл из Назарета в Галилее, и Иоанн крестил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} в Иордане.
ru.R: В то время Иисус пришёл из города Назарета в Галилее. Иоанн крестил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} в реке Иордан.

hi.L: और उन दिनों में ऐसा हुआ कि यीशु गलील के नासरत से आए, और यरदन में यूहन्ना से बपतिस्मा लिया।
hi.B: उन्हीं दिनों यीशु गलील के नासरत से आए, और यूहन्ना ने उन्हें यरदन में बपतिस्मा दिया।
hi.R: उस समय यीशु गलील प्रदेश के नासरत गाँव से आए। यूहन्ना ने उन्हें यरदन नदी में बपतिस्मा दिया।

uk.L: І сталося в ті дні: прийшов Ісус із Назарета галилейського і був охрещений Іваном у Йордані.
uk.B: У ті дні Ісус прийшов із Назарета в Галилеї, й Іван охрестив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} в Йордані.
uk.R: У той час Ісус прийшов із містечка Назарет у краю Галилея. Іван охрестив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} в річці Йордан.

ja.L: そして、それらの日々に、こういうことが起こった。イエスがガリラヤのナザレから来られ、ヨルダン[川]の中へ[入って]、ヨハネから洗礼を受けられた。
ja.B: そのころ、イエスはガリラヤのナザレから来られ、ヨルダン川でヨハネから洗礼を受けられた。
ja.R: そのころ、イエスはガリラヤ地方のナザレという町から来られました。そして、ヨルダン川でヨハネから洗礼を受けられました。

id.L: Dan terjadilah pada hari-hari itu, Yesus datang dari Nazaret di Galilea dan dibaptis di sungai Yordan oleh Yohanes.
id.B: Pada waktu itulah Yesus datang dari Nazaret di Galilea, dan Yohanes membaptis-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} di sungai Yordan.
id.R: Pada waktu itu Yesus datang dari kota Nazaret di daerah Galilea. Yohanes membaptis-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} di sungai Yordan.

zh.L: 在那些日子，耶稣从加利利的拿撒勒来，[进到]约旦河里，被约翰施洗。
zh.B: 就在那些日子，耶稣从加利利的拿撒勒来，约翰在约旦河里为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}施洗。
zh.R: 那时，耶稣从加利利地区的拿撒勒镇来。约翰在约旦河里为{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}施洗。

fa.L: و در آن روزها چنین شد که عیسی از ناصرهٔ جلیل آمد و از یحیی در اردن تعمید گرفت.
fa.B: در همان روزها عیسی از ناصره در جلیل آمد و یحیی او را در رود اردن تعمید داد.
fa.R: در همان زمان عیسی از شهر ناصره در سرزمین جلیل آمد. یحیی او را در رود اردن تعمید داد.

ar.L: وحدث في تلك الأيام أنّ يسوع جاء من ناصرة الجليل، واعتمد على يد يوحنا في الأردن.
ar.B: وفي تلك الأيام جاء يسوع من الناصرة في الجليل، فعمّده يوحنا في نهر الأردن.
ar.R: في ذلك الوقت جاء يسوع من بلدة الناصرة في منطقة الجليل. فعمّده يوحنا في نهر الأردن.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਉਂ ਹੋਇਆ [ਕਿ] ਯਿਸੂ ਗਲੀਲ ਦੇ ਨਾਸਰਤ ਤੋਂ ਆਏ ਅਤੇ ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਯਰਦਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਲਿਆ।
pa.B: ਉਨ੍ਹੀਂ ਦਿਨੀਂ ਯਿਸੂ ਗਲੀਲ ਦੇ ਨਾਸਰਤ ਤੋਂ ਆਏ, ਅਤੇ ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਯਰਦਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ।
pa.R: ਉਸ ਸਮੇਂ ਯਿਸੂ ਗਲੀਲ ਦੇ ਇਲਾਕੇ ਦੇ ਨਾਸਰਤ ਨਗਰ ਤੋਂ ਆਏ। ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਨੇ ਯਰਦਨ ਨਦੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਪਤਿਸਮਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ।

decisions.choice: it happened: the old biblical way of starting a new event
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the style of the Greek Old Testament and simply opens a new scene.

decisions.choice: Nazareth of Galilee: a small village in the hills of Galilee
decisions.reason: Nazareth is not named in the Old Testament and was an unimportant place (John 1:46). Galilee was the northern region, far from Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: into the Jordan: Jesus went down into the river
alternatives: at the Jordan, on the bank
decisions.reason: "Into" pictures him being dipped in the water. He comes up out of it in 1:10.

decisions.choice: it happened (L only); John baptized him (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable leave out the old opening phrase and make John the subject, which reads more naturally.

decisions.choice: Jesus stays the subject at every level: "요한에게 세례를 받으셨다"
alternatives: "요한이 예수께 세례를 주었다" (B, R), as the English
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable make John the subject; Korean says "received baptism from John" naturally, and keeping Jesus as the subject keeps the honorific -시- on the main verb of the sentence.

decisions.choice: "요단강에 [들어가]" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek "into the Jordan" implies going down into the river (meaning decision); Korean needs a verb for the movement, which Literal brackets.

decisions.choice: 'в Иордане'
decisions.reason: The Greek says 'into the Jordan'. Russian cannot say 'крещён в Иордан'; the meaning note says Jesus went down into the river, which 'в Иордане' still implies.

decisions.choice: honorific "आए", "उन्हें" for Jesus
decisions.reason: Jesus takes the honorific third person in the narrative throughout the book, as in Matthew. This is ordinary modern Hindi for a respected person, not an addition to the text.

decisions.choice: "у Йордані"
decisions.reason: Ukrainian "хрестити" does not take a phrase of motion into a place; the locative is used, and the going down into the river shows in 1:10, "виходячи з води".

decisions.choice: light respect forms for what Jesus and God do in narration ("来られた", "受けられた"; R "来られました")
alternatives: plain forms for Jesus, as for everyone else
decisions.reason: As in John and the other Gospels in Japanese, the narrator uses light respect forms (〜れる/〜られる, お〜になる) for what Jesus and God do, at every level, and for no one else. This holds through Mark. Jesus' own speech stays plain.

decisions.choice: "ヨハネから洗礼を受けられた" (B, R)
alternatives: "ヨハネはイエスに洗礼を授けた", as the English Balanced makes John the subject
decisions.reason: Japanese says naturally that Jesus received baptism from John, so Balanced and Readable keep Jesus as the subject; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: "在那些日子" with no word for "it happened" (L)
decisions.reason: The old opening "it happened" is rendered as a time phrase, as the style guide's formula table does for this opening.

decisions.choice: "وحدث ... أنّ"
decisions.reason: The old biblical opening of a new event (m1) is kept at Literal only, as in the English; Balanced and Readable start the scene with the time.

decisions.choice: Honorific plural for Jesus in the narrative ("ਆਏ", "ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ")
decisions.reason: Style §5.

source.text: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀναβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος εἶδεν σχιζομένους τοὺς οὐρανοὺς καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα ὡς περιστερὰν καταβαῖνον εἰς αὐτόν·

records.literal_gloss: And immediately going up out of the water he saw being torn open the heavens and the Spirit as a dove coming down into him.

en.L: And immediately, coming up out of the water, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit like a dove coming down to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: The moment {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came up out of the water, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the heavens torn apart and the Spirit coming down on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} like a dove.
en.R: Right away, as Jesus was coming up out of the water, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw heaven torn open. And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the Spirit coming down on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} like a dove.

vi.L: Và lập tức, khi đang lên khỏi nước, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy các tầng trời bị xé ra và Thánh Linh như chim bồ câu giáng xuống trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vừa lên khỏi nước, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} liền thấy các tầng trời xé toạc ra và Thánh Linh giáng xuống trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như chim bồ câu.
vi.R: Ngay lúc Đức Giê-xu từ dưới nước đi lên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy bầu trời bị xé ra. Ngài cũng thấy Thánh Linh đang xuống trên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như một con chim bồ câu.

ko.L: 그리고 곧 물에서 올라오시면서, 그분은 하늘이 찢어지는 것과 성령께서 비둘기처럼 자신에게로 내려오시는 것을 보셨다.
ko.B: 예수께서 물에서 올라오시자마자, 하늘이 찢어져 열리고 성령께서 비둘기처럼 자신에게 내려오시는 것을 보셨다.
ko.R: 예수께서 물에서 올라오실 때, 곧바로 하늘이 찢어지듯 열리는 것을 보셨다. 그리고 성령께서 비둘기처럼 그분 위로 내려오시는 것도 보셨다.

es.L: Y enseguida, subiendo del agua, vio los cielos rasgándose y al Espíritu, como paloma, descendiendo hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: En cuanto salió del agua, vio que los cielos se rasgaban y que el Espíritu bajaba sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} como una paloma.
es.R: Enseguida, cuando Jesús salía del agua, vio que el cielo se rasgaba. Y vio al Espíritu, que bajaba sobre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} como una paloma.

fr.L: Et aussitôt, remontant de l’eau, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit les cieux qui se déchiraient et l’Esprit qui, comme une colombe, descendait sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Au moment où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} remontait de l’eau, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit les cieux se déchirer et l’Esprit descendre sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme une colombe.
fr.R: Tout de suite, pendant que Jésus sortait de l’eau, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu le ciel se déchirer. Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a vu l’Esprit descendre sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme une colombe.

sw.L: Na mara moja, alipokuwa akipanda kutoka majini, aliona mbingu zikipasuliwa, na Roho kama njiwa akishuka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.B: Mara moja alipotoka majini, aliona mbingu zimepasuka, na Roho akishuka juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama njiwa.
sw.R: Papo hapo, Yesu alipokuwa akitoka majini, aliona mbingu zikipasuka. Akamwona Roho akishuka juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama njiwa.

pt.L: E imediatamente, subindo da água, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} viu os céus se rasgando e o Espírito descendo como uma pomba até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.B: No momento em que saiu da água, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} viu os céus se rasgarem e o Espírito descer sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} como uma pomba.
pt.R: Na mesma hora, quando Jesus estava saindo da água, viu o céu se rasgar. Ele viu também o Espírito descer sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} como uma pomba.

am.L: ወዲያውኑም ከውኃው ሲወጣ ሰማያት ሲቀደዱና መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ ወደ እርሱ ሲወርድ አየ።
am.B: ከውኃው እንደ ወጣ ወዲያውኑ ሰማይ ተቀድዶ መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ በእርሱ ላይ ሲወርድ አየ።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ከውኃው ሲወጣ ወዲያው ሰማይ ሲቀደድ አየ። መንፈስም እንደ ርግብ በእርሱ ላይ ሲወርድ አየ።

ru.L: И тотчас, выходя из воды, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} увидел разрывающиеся небеса и Духа, как голубя, сходящего на {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.
ru.B: В тот же миг, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} выходил из воды, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} увидел, как разорвались небеса и Дух, словно голубь, спускается на {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.
ru.R: Сразу, когда Иисус выходил из воды, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} увидел, что небо разорвалось. И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} увидел, как Дух спускается на {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}, словно голубь.

hi.L: और तुरंत पानी से ऊपर आते हुए उन्होंने आकाश को फटते और आत्मा को कबूतर के समान अपने ऊपर उतरते देखा।
hi.B: जैसे ही वे पानी से ऊपर आए, उन्होंने देखा कि आकाश फट गया है और आत्मा कबूतर की तरह उन पर उतर रहा है।
hi.R: पानी से बाहर आते ही यीशु ने देखा कि आकाश फटकर खुल गया है। और उन्होंने आत्मा को कबूतर की तरह अपने ऊपर उतरते देखा।

uk.L: І зараз же, виходячи з води, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} побачив, як розриваються небеса і Дух, як голуб, сходить на {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.
uk.B: Щойно виходячи з води, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} побачив розірвані небеса і Духа, що сходив на {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}, мов голуб.
uk.R: Відразу, коли Ісус виходив із води, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} побачив, що небо розірвалося. І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} побачив, як Дух, наче голуб, спускається на {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.

ja.L: そしてすぐに、水から上がりながら、天が裂かれていくのと、霊が鳩のようにご自分のところへ降って来られるのを、ご覧になった。
ja.B: 水から上がられたその瞬間、イエスは天が裂けて、霊が鳩のようにご自分の上に降って来られるのをご覧になった。
ja.R: 水から上がって来られると、すぐに、イエスは天が大きく裂けるのをご覧になりました。そして、霊が鳩のようにご自分の上に降って来られるのをご覧になりました。

id.L: Dan segera, ketika keluar dari air, {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} melihat langit terkoyak dan Roh seperti burung merpati turun kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.
id.B: Begitu keluar dari air, {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} melihat langit terkoyak dan Roh turun ke atas-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} seperti burung merpati.
id.R: Segera sesudah Yesus keluar dari air, {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} melihat langit terbuka lebar. Dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} melihat Roh turun ke atas-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} seperti burung merpati.

zh.L: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}立即从水里上来，就看见天正在裂开，圣灵如同鸽子降到{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}身上。
zh.B: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}刚从水里上来，就看见天裂开了，圣灵像鸽子一样降在{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}身上。
zh.R: 耶稣从水里上来的时候，{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}马上看见天被撕开了。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}又看见圣灵像鸽子一样降到{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}身上。

fa.L: و فوراً، هنگامی که از آب بیرون می‌آمد، دید که آسمان‌ها شکافته می‌شوند و روح همچون کبوتری بر او فرود می‌آید.
fa.B: همین که از آب بیرون آمد، دید که آسمان‌ها شکافته شد و روح همچون کبوتری بر او فرود آمد.
fa.R: همان وقت که عیسی از آب بیرون می‌آمد، دید که آسمان باز شد. و دید که روح خدا مانند کبوتری بر او فرود می‌آید.

ar.L: وللوقت، وهو يصعد من الماء، رأى السماوات تنشقّ، والروح مثل حمامة نازلًا إليه.
ar.B: وما إن صعد من الماء حتّى رأى السماوات منشقّة، والروح ينزل عليه كأنّه حمامة.
ar.R: وفي الحال، بينما كان يسوع يخرج من الماء، رأى السماء تنفتح انفتاحًا عنيفًا، ورأى الروح ينزل عليه مثل حمامة.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਅਕਾਸ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਾਟਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਆਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਘੁੱਗੀ ਵਾਂਗ ਆਪਣੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਉੱਤਰਦੇ ਵੇਖਿਆ।
pa.B: ਜਿਉਂ ਹੀ ਉਹ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਬਾਹਰ ਆਏ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਵੇਖਿਆ ਕਿ ਅਕਾਸ਼ ਪਾਟ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਆਤਮਾ ਘੁੱਗੀ ਵਾਂਗ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਉੱਤਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ।
pa.R: ਜਦੋਂ ਯਿਸੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲ ਹੀ ਰਹੇ ਸਨ, ਤਾਂ ਉਸੇ ਵੇਲੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਅਕਾਸ਼ ਨੂੰ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਦੇ ਵੇਖਿਆ। ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਘੁੱਗੀ ਵਾਂਗ ਆਪਣੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਵੇਖਿਆ।

decisions.choice: immediately: Mark's word for moving the story straight on
decisions.reason: Mark uses this word more than forty times, eleven in this chapter. Often it means "at once"; sometimes it just carries the reader into the next event.

decisions.choice: torn open: a violent tearing, not a gentle opening
decisions.reason: The same verb is used when the temple curtain is torn from top to bottom at Jesus' death (15:38). Isaiah 64:1 asks God to tear open the heavens and come down.

decisions.choice: he saw: Jesus is the one who sees
decisions.reason: The subject is still Jesus, who is coming up out of the water, and the voice in 1:11 speaks to him.

decisions.choice: like a dove: the Spirit's coming down is compared to a dove
alternatives: the Spirit took the bodily form of a dove
decisions.reason: The words can describe the way the Spirit came down or what was seen. Luke 3:22 says it was in bodily form; Mark only gives the comparison.

decisions.choice: to him: the Spirit came down upon him
decisions.reason: The word can mean "into", but after a verb of coming down it is often "to" or "upon", as in Matthew 3:16.

decisions.choice: immediately (L); the moment (B); right away (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one word for this Greek word throughout. Balanced and Readable vary it, so that Mark's quick pace does not become a repeated word in English.

decisions.choice: "lập tức" (L); "liền", "vừa ... liền", "ngay" (B); "ngay lúc", "ngay sau đó" (R) for Mark's "immediately"
decisions.reason: Mark uses the word very often to move the story on. Literal keeps one word so the reader sees it recur; Balanced and Readable use the shorter words Vietnamese uses for the same quickness. Holds for the book.

decisions.choice: "곧" (L) for Mark's "immediately" throughout; "-자마자", "곧바로", "바로", "즉시" as the sentence allows (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark uses the word over forty times to move the story on (meaning decision). Literal keeps one Korean word for it, so the reader can see the repetition; Balanced and Readable vary it as natural Korean does.

decisions.choice: "성령께서 ... 내려오시는" with the honorific
decisions.reason: The Spirit is God and takes "께서" and -시- in the narrative, as in John 1:32. Here "the Spirit" alone is the Holy Spirit, so Korean says "성령" (style guide).

decisions.choice: enseguida (L, R); en cuanto, al instante, en ese momento (B)
decisions.reason: Mark's word for moving the story straight on (meaning decision m1). Literal says "enseguida" every time so readers can see how often Mark uses it; Balanced uses whatever Spanish says most naturally in the sentence; Readable keeps "enseguida". This applies throughout the book.

decisions.choice: rasgarse
decisions.reason: A tearing apart, not a gentle opening (meaning decision m2); Spanish "abrirse" would lose the force, and "rasgar" is the verb used for the temple curtain in 15:38.

decisions.choice: aussitôt (L); varied at Balanced ("au moment où", "aussitôt", "sans tarder", "sur-le-champ"); tout de suite (R), for the whole book
decisions.reason: Mark's favourite connective (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps one word, "aussitôt", so the reader can see how often Mark uses it; Balanced lets the French sentence decide, as the English does; Readable says "tout de suite", the everyday word.

decisions.choice: mara moja for "immediately" at Literal, every time in Mark; Balanced and Readable may vary (mara moja, mara hiyo, papo hapo, or folded into the sentence)
decisions.reason: Mark's "immediately" moves the story straight on (meaning decision). Literal says "mara moja" (at once) each time, so the reader sees how often Mark uses the word; bare "mara" is easily read as "time" or "as soon as". Balanced and Readable say it naturally and may fold it into the sentence. "Ghafla" would add surprise, which the word does not carry. Used through Mark.

decisions.choice: se rasgando, se rasgarem, se rasgar
alternatives: se abrindo, se abrirem (as in Matthew 3:16)
decisions.reason: Matthew's verb is "open" and Portuguese says "os céus se abriram" there. Mark's verb is a violent tearing (m2), the one used for the temple curtain in 15:38, so Portuguese says "rasgar" at every level and does not take Matthew's wording.

decisions.choice: "ሲቀደዱ", "ተቀድዶ" (being torn open)
decisions.reason: Mark's verb is a violent tearing, the word he uses again for the temple curtain (15:38), so Amharic says "መቀደድ" (to tear) and does not take Matthew's "ተከፈቱ".

decisions.choice: "ወዲያውኑ" (immediately) at Literal for Mark's recurring word
alternatives: a different word each time at Literal
decisions.reason: Mark uses the word over forty times to move the story on. Literal keeps one word, "ወዲያውኑ", so the repetition shows; Balanced and Readable vary it ("ወዲያው", "በዚያው ቅጽበት", "ሳይዘገዩ") or leave it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'тотчас' (L); 'в тот же миг', 'тут же', 'сразу', 'не медля' (B); 'сразу', 'тут же' (R)
decisions.reason: Mark's frequent 'immediately' (euthys). Literal keeps one word for it throughout, 'тотчас', as in Matthew. Balanced and Readable vary it in everyday words so that Mark's quick pace does not become a repeated word.

decisions.choice: 'разрывающиеся', 'разорвались' (not 'открылись')
decisions.reason: Mark's verb is a violent tearing, not Matthew's 'opened', so the Russian differs from Matthew here as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "तुरंत" (L, every time); varied with the sentence (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark's frequent "immediately" (euthys) is always "तुरंत" at Literal, so the reader can follow Mark's quick pace. Balanced and Readable say it as the sentence needs ("तुरंत", "उसी समय", "जैसे ही" or "-ते ही", "फ़ौरन"), or let a clause carry it, so that it does not become one repeated word. The same treatment holds through Mark.

decisions.choice: "फटते", "फट गया"
decisions.reason: Mark's word is a violent tearing (meaning note), not Matthew's "opened" (Matthew 3:16), so the Hindi differs from Matthew here.

decisions.choice: euthys: "зараз же" (L); varied at B and R ("щойно", "відразу", "одразу")
decisions.reason: Settled for the Gospels: Literal keeps one word for Mark's frequent euthys; Balanced and Readable vary it as Ukrainian storytelling does.

decisions.choice: "すぐに" (L); "その瞬間" (B); "すぐに" (R)
decisions.reason: Mark's frequent word for "immediately" (m1) is "すぐに" at Literal every time in the book, so a reader can follow it. Balanced and Readable vary it ("その瞬間", "ただちに", "すぐさま", "すぐ") as the English does, so that Mark's quick pace does not become one repeated word.

decisions.choice: "裂かれていく" (L); "裂けて" (B); "大きく裂ける" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is a violent tearing (m2), the one used of the temple curtain in 15:38, so Japanese says "裂ける" rather than a gentle opening.

decisions.choice: respect form for the Spirit: "降って来られる"
decisions.reason: The Spirit is God's Spirit and takes the light respect forms the narration uses for God, as in 1:12 ("押し出される"); the same holds through the book.

decisions.choice: "segera" (L) for euthys; "begitu", "segera", "langsung" (B, R) as the sentence needs
decisions.reason: Mark's word that moves the story straight on (m1) is "segera" at Literal throughout the book; Balanced and Readable choose the natural Indonesian connective, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "立即" (L, every time); "刚……就", "随即", "马上" (B); "马上", "立刻" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one word for Mark's "immediately" throughout. Balanced and Readable vary it, so that Mark's quick pace does not become a repeated word.

decisions.choice: "裂开" (L, B); "撕开" (R)
decisions.reason: Mark's verb is a violent tearing, not Matthew's "opened" (Matthew 3:16), so the Chinese differs from Matthew here.

decisions.choice: "فوراً" for euthys at Literal, every time; varied at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Mark's "immediately" is one of his marks of style; Literal keeps one word for it through the book so a reader can see how often it comes, as the English Literal does. Balanced and Readable say "بی‌درنگ", "همان دم", "درست پس از آن" or leave it out as the sentence needs.

decisions.choice: "شکافته می‌شوند", "شکافته شد"
decisions.reason: The heavens are torn, the same verb Mark uses of the temple curtain in 15:38; Persian keeps "شکافته شدن" in both places.

decisions.choice: "للوقت" (L), "ما إن ... حتّى" (B), "في الحال" (R) for euthys; "تنشقّ" for the tearing
decisions.reason: Mark's "immediately" (m1) recurs through the book: Literal keeps one form, "للوقت", and Balanced and Readable say it in the way the sentence needs. "انشقّ" is a tearing apart, as of the temple curtain in 15:38 (m2), not a gentle opening.

decisions.choice: "ਤੁਰੰਤ" (L, every time); varied with the sentence (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark's euthys.

decisions.choice: "ਪਾਟਦੇ", "ਪਾਟ ਗਿਆ" (L, B); "ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਦੇ" (R)
decisions.reason: Torn open, as the temple curtain in 15:38.

source.text: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν· Σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα.

records.literal_gloss: And a voice came out of the heavens, You are the Son of me the beloved, in you I was well pleased.

en.L: And a voice came out of the heavens: "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son, the beloved; in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I am well pleased."
en.B: Then a voice spoke from heaven: "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} dearly loved Son. I take delight in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.R: Then a voice from heaven said, "You are {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Son, and I love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. I am very pleased with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."

vi.L: Và có tiếng từ các tầng trời [phán]: "Con là Con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, Đấng yêu dấu; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đẹp lòng về Con."
vi.B: Rồi có tiếng từ trời phán: "Con là Con yêu dấu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta rất vui lòng về Con."
vi.R: Rồi có tiếng từ trời phán: "Con là Con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} yêu thương Con. Ta rất hài lòng về Con."

ko.L: 그리고 하늘들에서 소리가 났다. "너는 나의 아들, 사랑하는 [아들]이다. 너를 내가 기뻐한다."
ko.B: 그때 하늘에서 소리가 들려왔다. "너는 내가 사랑하는 아들이다. 나는 너를 기뻐한다."
ko.R: 그러자 하늘에서 소리가 들렸다. "너는 내 아들이다. 나는 너를 사랑한다. 나는 너를 무척 기뻐한다."

es.L: Y vino una voz de los cielos: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo, el amado; en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me he complacido».
es.B: Entonces una voz habló desde el cielo: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo amado; en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me complazco».
es.R: Entonces una voz del cielo dijo: «Tú eres {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Hijo, y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} amo. En {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} encuentro {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alegría».

fr.L: Et une voix vint des cieux : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils, le bien-aimé ; en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je prends plaisir. »
fr.B: Puis une voix se fit entendre du ciel : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils bien-aimé ; en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je trouve toute {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} joie. »
fr.R: Puis une voix venant du ciel a dit : « Tu es {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Fils, et je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}aime. Je suis très content de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »

sw.L: Na sauti ikatoka mbinguni: "Wewe ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, mpendwa; ndani {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nimependezwa."
sw.B: Kisha sauti ikasema kutoka mbinguni: "Wewe ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mpendwa. Nafurahishwa sana {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}."
sw.R: Kisha sauti kutoka mbinguni ikasema, "Wewe ni Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nakupenda. Unanifurahisha sana."

pt.L: E veio uma voz dos céus: "Tu és o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho, o amado; em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} eu tenho prazer."
pt.B: Então uma voz falou do céu: "Tu és o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho amado; em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} tenho grande alegria."
pt.R: Então uma voz do céu disse: "Tu és o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Filho, e eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} amo. Estou muito contente {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}."

am.L: ከሰማያትም እንዲህ የሚል ድምፅ መጣ፦ «አንተ ልጄ፣ የምወድህ ነህ፤ በአንተ ደስ ተሰኘሁ።»
am.B: ከሰማይም እንዲህ የሚል ድምፅ ተሰማ፦ «እጅግ የምወድህ ልጄ አንተ ነህ፤ በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል።»
am.R: ከዚያም ከሰማይ አንድ ድምፅ እንዲህ አለ፦ «አንተ ልጄ ነህ፤ እወድሃለሁ። በአንተም እጅግ ደስ ብሎኛል።»

ru.L: И голос был с небес: «Ты {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Сын, возлюбленный; к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} благоволю.»
ru.B: Тогда с неба прозвучал голос: «Ты — {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} любимый Сын. Я радуюсь о {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.»
ru.R: Тогда голос с неба сказал: «Ты — {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} Сын, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} люблю {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Я очень доволен {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}.»

hi.L: और स्वर्ग से एक आवाज़ आई: "तू मेरा पुत्र है, वह प्रिय; तुझसे मुझे प्रसन्नता है।"
hi.B: तब स्वर्ग से एक आवाज़ आई: "तू मेरा प्यारा पुत्र है। मैं तुझसे बहुत प्रसन्न हूँ।"
hi.R: तब स्वर्ग से एक आवाज़ ने कहा, "तू मेरा पुत्र है, और मैं तुझसे प्रेम करता हूँ। मैं तुझसे बहुत ख़ुश हूँ।"

uk.L: І голос пролунав з небес: «Ти — Син {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} улюблений, у {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} знайшов уподобання.»
uk.B: Тоді з неба пролунав голос: «Ти — {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} улюблений Син, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} до вподоби.»
uk.R: Тоді голос із неба сказав: «Ти — {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} Син, і {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} люблю {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Я дуже задоволений {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}.»

ja.L: そして天から声があった。「あなたはわたしの子、愛する者である。わたしはあなたを喜んでいる。」
ja.B: すると、天から声がした。「あなたはわたしの愛する子。わたしはあなたを深く喜んでいる。」
ja.R: すると、天から声が聞こえました。「あなたはわたしの子。わたしはあなたを愛している。あなたのことを、とても喜んでいる。」

id.L: Dan terdengarlah suara dari langit: "Engkaulah Anak-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang terkasih; kepada-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}lah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} berkenan."
id.B: Lalu terdengar suara dari surga: "Engkaulah Anak-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang sangat {{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}kasihi. Aku berkenan kepada-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}."
id.R: Lalu terdengar suara dari surga, "Engkau Anak-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} mengasihi-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}. Aku sangat senang kepada-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}."

zh.L: 又有声音从天上来：“{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}是我的儿子，那蒙爱的；我以{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}为喜悦。”
zh.B: 接着有声音从天上说：“{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}是我深爱的儿子，我非常喜爱{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}。”
zh.R: 接着，有声音从天上说：“{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}是我的儿子，我爱{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}。我对{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}非常满意。”

fa.L: و صدایی از آسمان‌ها آمد: «تو پسر من هستی، آن محبوب؛ از تو خشنودم.»
fa.B: آن‌گاه صدایی از آسمان گفت: «تو پسر عزیز من هستی. از تو بسیار خشنودم.»
fa.R: آن‌گاه صدایی از آسمان گفت: «تو پسر من هستی و من تو را دوست دارم. از تو بسیار خشنودم.»

ar.L: وخرج صوت من السماوات: «أنت هو ابني، الحبيب؛ بك سُررت».
ar.B: ثمّ تكلّم صوت من السماء: «أنت ابني المحبوب، وأنا أفرح بك».
ar.R: ثمّ قال صوت من السماء: «أنت ابني، وأنا أحبّك. أنا راضٍ عنك كلّ الرضا».

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਅਕਾਸ਼ਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਆਈ: "ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਹੈਂ, ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਮੈਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹਾਂ।"
pa.B: ਫਿਰ ਸਵਰਗ ਤੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਬੋਲੀ: "ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਹੈਂ। ਮੈਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਾਣਦਾ ਹਾਂ।"
pa.R: ਫਿਰ ਸਵਰਗ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਨੇ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁੱਤਰ ਹੈਂ, ਅਤੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ। ਮੈਂ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਬਹੁਤ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ ਹਾਂ।"

decisions.choice: you are my Son ... I am well pleased: Psalm 2:7 and Isaiah 42:1
decisions.reason: In Psalm 2:7 God says to his anointed king, "You are my son". In Isaiah 42:1 God delights in his chosen servant and puts his Spirit on him. "Beloved son" also recalls Isaac (Genesis 22:2).

decisions.choice: I am well pleased: a settled delight
alternatives: God became pleased at the baptism
decisions.reason: The past tense here states God's approval as a fact, not a change that has just happened.

decisions.choice: You are: the voice speaks to Jesus himself
alternatives: the voice speaks about him to the crowd
decisions.reason: In Mark the voice says "you". Matthew 3:17 has "This is", addressed to those present.

decisions.choice: Son with a capital letter
decisions.reason: The word is a title here, as in 1:1 and 15:39, so it is capitalized, as at Matthew 3:17.

decisions.choice: the voice says "Ta" and "Con" for "you"; "phán" (B, R; in brackets at L, as in 9:7)
decisions.reason: The Father speaks to the Son as a father does, "Con", a noun of address that is always capitalised and takes no setting span (style guide, section 7). "phán" is kept for God speaking.

decisions.choice: "하늘들" (L), "하늘" (B, R); "사랑하는 [아들]" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek plural "heavens", which Korean can mark with "-들"; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary singular. The Greek adds "the beloved" after "my Son" as a second title; Literal keeps it apart and brackets the noun Korean needs. The Father speaks to the Son in the plain style (해라체), as in 1:2.

decisions.choice: «Tú eres» plain; no span on the reflexive "me"
decisions.reason: "Tú" opens the quoted sentence, so it is capitalised either way and written plain. In "me complazco" the pronoun only marks the verb as reflexive, as in Hebrews 3:11, and stands for no English word, so it takes no setting.

decisions.choice: en toi je prends plaisir (L); en toi je trouve toute ma joie (B); je suis très content de toi (R)
alternatives: en toi j’ai mis toute mon affection
decisions.reason: The verb speaks of a settled delight (meaning decision m2). The familiar older wording speaks of affection, which is not the sense; Balanced says "joie", and its "ma", God speaking, takes a deity_pronoun span like "mon".

decisions.choice: Tu és ...; em ti eu tenho prazer (L); em ti tenho grande alegria (B); estou muito contente contigo (R)
decisions.reason: The voice speaks to Jesus (m3), so God's "tu" replaces Matthew's "Este é"; the rest keeps the wording of Matthew 3:17 at each level ("o meu Filho, o amado", "tenho prazer", "muito contente"), since the Greek agrees.

decisions.choice: 'Ты' (not 'Это' as in Matthew 3:17)
decisions.reason: In Mark the voice speaks to Jesus himself ('You are'), where Matthew has 'This is', so the Russian follows the Greek and differs from Matthew.

decisions.choice: "तू", "तुझसे" in the Father's words to Jesus
decisions.reason: In Mark the voice speaks to Jesus himself (meaning note), where Matthew has "This is". A father speaks to his son with the intimate "तू", the same address God uses to the coming one in 1:2.

decisions.choice: "喜んでいる" (L, B, R)
alternatives: "喜んだ", following the Greek past tense
decisions.reason: The past tense states God's settled delight in his Son (m2), not a feeling that has just begun; the Japanese "〜ている" says that lasting state. The voice is God's own, so it speaks in the plain style.

decisions.choice: "我的儿子" with no span; "{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}" for the Son
alternatives: "我" in a span, as the English "my"
decisions.reason: God speaks: "我" takes no span in Chinese. The voice speaks to Jesus, so Matthew 3:17's wording is kept with "你" for "他".

decisions.choice: "تو", "از تو" in the Father's words to Jesus
decisions.reason: God speaks to his Son with "تو", as Persian always addresses one person from God (style guide section 5).

decisions.choice: "الحبيب" (L), "المحبوب" (B); "بك سُررت" (L), "أنا أفرح بك" (B), "راضٍ عنك" (R)
decisions.reason: The words echo Psalm 2:7 and Isaiah 42:1 (m1), and the past tense states a settled delight (m2), which Literal's perfect keeps and Balanced and Readable say in the present. The wording is the drafters' own; Van Dyck's familiar sentence is not followed.

decisions.choice: "ਤੂੰ", "ਤੇਰੇ" in the Father's words to Jesus
decisions.reason: God says ਤੂੰ to one person (style §5).

source.text: Καὶ εὐθὺς τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτὸν ἐκβάλλει εἰς τὴν ἔρημον.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately the Spirit him drives out into the wilderness.

en.L: And immediately the Spirit drives {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} out into the wilderness.
en.B: Straight away the Spirit drove {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} out into the wilderness.
en.R: Right after that, the Spirit pushed Jesus to go out into the desert.

vi.L: Và lập tức Thánh Linh đẩy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra đồng hoang.
vi.B: Ngay sau đó, Thánh Linh đẩy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào đồng hoang.
vi.R: Ngay sau đó, Thánh Linh thúc Đức Giê-xu đi vào sa mạc.

ko.L: 그리고 곧 성령께서 그분을 광야로 내모신다.
ko.B: 곧이어 성령께서 예수를 광야로 내모셨다.
ko.R: 그 뒤 바로 성령께서 예수를 빈 들로 떠밀어 보내셨다.

es.L: Y enseguida el Espíritu {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} echa fuera, al desierto.
es.B: Enseguida el Espíritu {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} impulsó a salir al desierto.
es.R: Enseguida, el Espíritu hizo que Jesús se fuera al desierto.

fr.L: Et aussitôt l’Esprit {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pousse au désert.
fr.B: Aussitôt après, l’Esprit {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} poussa au désert.
fr.R: Tout de suite après, l’Esprit a poussé Jésus à aller dans le désert.

sw.L: Na mara moja Roho anamsukuma nje kwenda nyikani.
sw.B: Mara moja Roho alimsukuma aende nyikani.
sw.R: Mara moja baada ya hapo, Roho alimsukuma Yesu aende jangwani.

pt.L: E imediatamente o Espírito {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} impele para o deserto.
pt.B: Sem demora, o Espírito {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} impeliu para o deserto.
pt.R: Logo depois disso, o Espírito fez Jesus ir para o deserto.

am.L: ወዲያውኑም መንፈስ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ያስወጣዋል።
am.B: ወዲያውም መንፈስ ወደ ምድረ በዳ አስገድዶ ወሰደው።
am.R: ከዚያ በኋላ ወዲያው መንፈስ ኢየሱስን ወደ በረሃ እንዲሄድ ገፋፋው።

ru.L: И тотчас Дух выгоняет {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} в пустыню.
ru.B: Тут же Дух властно отправил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} в пустыню.
ru.R: Сразу после этого Дух заставил Иисуса уйти в пустыню.

hi.L: और तुरंत आत्मा उन्हें निर्जन प्रदेश में धकेल देता है।
hi.B: इसके तुरंत बाद आत्मा उन्हें ज़ोर देकर निर्जन प्रदेश में ले गया।
hi.R: इसके तुरंत बाद आत्मा ने यीशु को ज़ोर देकर सुनसान इलाक़े में भेज दिया।

uk.L: І зараз же Дух виганяє {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} в пустелю.
uk.B: Відразу Дух погнав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} в пустелю.
uk.R: Одразу після цього Дух змусив Ісуса піти в пустелю.

ja.L: そしてすぐに、霊はイエスを荒れ野へ押し出される。
ja.B: そしてただちに、霊はイエスを荒れ野へ押し出された。
ja.R: そのすぐ後、霊はイエスを荒れ野へと強く押し出されました。

id.L: Dan segera Roh mendorong-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} keluar ke padang gurun.
id.B: Segera sesudah itu Roh mendorong-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} pergi ke padang gurun.
id.R: Sesudah itu, Roh membawa Yesus pergi ke padang gurun.

zh.L: 圣灵立即把{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}赶到旷野去。
zh.B: 圣灵随即催逼{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}到旷野去。
zh.R: 那以后，圣灵马上催促耶稣到荒野去。

fa.L: و فوراً روح او را به بیابان می‌راند.
fa.B: بی‌درنگ روح او را به بیابان راند.
fa.R: درست پس از آن، روح خدا عیسی را واداشت که به بیابان برود.

ar.L: وللوقت يُخرجه الروح إلى البرّيّة.
ar.B: وفي الحال دفعه الروح إلى البرّيّة.
ar.R: وبعد ذلك مباشرة، دفع الروح يسوع ليذهب إلى الصحراء.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਆਤਮਾ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਜਾੜ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੱਢ ਲੈ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
pa.B: ਉਸੇ ਘੜੀ ਆਤਮਾ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਜਾੜ ਵੱਲ ਤੋਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ।
pa.R: ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਛੇਤੀ ਬਾਅਦ, ਆਤਮਾ ਨੇ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਸੁੰਨਸਾਨ ਥਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਣ ਲਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਆ।

decisions.choice: drives out: sends with force
decisions.reason: This is the verb used for casting out demons (1:34, 39). It shows urgency and the Spirit's power, not hostility. Matthew 4:1 and Luke 4:1 say "led".

decisions.choice: drives: the present tense of storytelling
decisions.reason: Mark often tells past events in the present tense to make them vivid.

decisions.choice: the wilderness: where Israel was tested
decisions.reason: Israel was led through the wilderness for forty years and tested there (Deuteronomy 8:2).

decisions.choice: drives (L); drove (B); pushed ... to go (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Mark's present tense. Balanced and Readable use the past, as English tells a story.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal by leaving out "đã" ("đẩy", 1:21 "vào", 1:30 "nói")
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no verb endings; Literal keeps Mark's present-tense storytelling by not adding "đã", as the style guide says, while Balanced and Readable tell it as plain narrative. Holds for the chapter.

decisions.choice: historic present at Literal ("내모신다", "들어간다", "말씀하신다"); past at Balanced and Readable, through Mark 1
decisions.reason: Mark often tells past events in the present for vividness (meaning decision); Korean narrative can do the same, so Literal keeps it, as the Korean of John does. One decision for the chapter.

decisions.choice: present tense (L); past tense (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in John: Mark often tells his story in the present tense (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable use the past, as Spanish stories do. This applies throughout the book.

decisions.choice: pousse (L); poussa (B)
decisions.reason: The verb means to send out with force (meaning decision m1). "Pousser" keeps the force without the hostility of "chasser", the French word used for driving out demons.

decisions.choice: historic present kept at Literal (anamsukuma); past at Balanced and Readable (alimsukuma)
decisions.reason: Mark often tells past events in the present (meaning decision). Literal keeps it, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the narrative past with -li- and -ka-, as written Swahili tells a story. This holds for every historic present in chapters 1-2.

decisions.choice: historic present "ያስወጣዋል" (drives him out) at Literal
decisions.reason: Mark often tells past events in the present tense. Literal keeps it ("ያስወጣዋል", "ይገባሉ", "ይላቸዋል"); Balanced and Readable use the past, as Amharic narrative normally does.

decisions.choice: 'выгоняет' (L); 'властно отправил' (B); 'заставил ... уйти' (R)
decisions.reason: Mark's verb means to drive out with force, stronger than Matthew's 'led up'. Each level keeps the force; Literal keeps the present tense.

decisions.choice: "धकेल देता है" (L); past tense (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Mark's historic present wherever he has it; Balanced and Readable use the past, as Hindi tells a story. Used through Mark.

decisions.choice: present "押し出される" (L); past "押し出された" (B), "押し出されました" (R)
decisions.reason: Mark tells past events in the present tense to make them vivid (m2). Literal keeps the present; Balanced and Readable narrate in the past, as Japanese storytelling does. This holds for the historic presents through this passage.

decisions.choice: "押し出す" with a respect form for the Spirit ("押し出される")
alternatives: "追い出す", the verb used for casting out demons
decisions.reason: The verb sends with force (m1), but Japanese "追い出す" would sound like driving out something unwanted, so "押し出す" keeps the force without hostility. The Spirit is God's Spirit and takes the respect forms used for God, as in Acts ("聖霊が語られた"); with "イエスを" as the object the form cannot be read as a passive.

decisions.choice: "می‌راند" (Literal, present); past tense (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Mark often tells the story in the present tense; Literal keeps his present ("drives", "comes", "says") where the English Literal does, and the other levels use the simple past of Persian narrative (style guide section 5).

decisions.choice: present "يُخرجه" (L); past "دفعه" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark's storytelling present (m2) is kept at Literal. The verb is the one used for casting out demons and means sending with force (m1); "أخرج" and "دفع" keep the force without the hostility of "طرد".

decisions.choice: "ਲੈ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ" (L); past tense (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark's historical present.

source.text: καὶ ἦν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ, καὶ ἦν μετὰ τῶν θηρίων, καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι διηκόνουν αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: And he was in the wilderness forty days being tempted by the Satan, and was with the wild beasts, and the angels were serving him.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was with the wild animals, and the angels were serving {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: He stayed in the wilderness for forty days while Satan tempted {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He was among the wild animals, and the angels took care of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Jesus was in the desert for forty days, and Satan tried to make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} do wrong. Wild animals were there with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and angels took care of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở trong đồng hoang bốn mươi ngày, bị Sa-tan cám dỗ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở với các thú dữ, và các thiên sứ phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài ở trong đồng hoang bốn mươi ngày, chịu Sa-tan cám dỗ. Ngài ở giữa các thú dữ, và các thiên sứ chăm sóc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu ở trong sa mạc bốn mươi ngày, và Sa-tan tìm cách khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm điều sai. Có thú dữ ở đó với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và các thiên sứ chăm sóc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 사십 일 동안 광야에 계시면서 사탄에게 시험을 받으셨다. 그리고 들짐승들과 함께 계셨고, 천사들이 그분을 섬기고 있었다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 사십 일 동안 광야에 계시면서 사탄에게 시험을 받으셨다. 들짐승들과 함께 지내셨고, 천사들이 그분의 시중을 들었다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 빈 들에서 사십 일을 지내셨다. 그동안 사탄이 예수를 꾀어 죄를 짓게 하려고 했다. 들짐승들도 그곳에 함께 있었고, 천사들이 예수를 돌보아 드렸다.

es.L: Y estuvo en el desierto cuarenta días, siendo tentado por Satanás, y estaba con las fieras, y los ángeles {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servían.
es.B: Permaneció en el desierto cuarenta días mientras Satanás {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} tentaba. Estaba entre los animales salvajes, y los ángeles {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} atendían.
es.R: Jesús estuvo en el desierto cuarenta días, y Satanás {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ponía a prueba para que hiciera lo malo. Los animales salvajes estaban allí con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y los ángeles {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} cuidaban.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était dans le désert quarante jours, tenté par Satan ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était avec les bêtes sauvages, et les anges {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servaient.
fr.B: Il resta quarante jours dans le désert, où Satan {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tentait. Il vivait parmi les bêtes sauvages, et les anges prenaient soin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Jésus est resté quarante jours dans le désert, et Satan a essayé de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pousser à faire le mal. Des bêtes sauvages étaient là avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et des anges prenaient soin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa nyikani siku arobaini akijaribiwa na Shetani, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} alikuwa pamoja na wanyama wa porini, na malaika walikuwa wakimtumikia.
sw.B: Alikaa nyikani siku arobaini, Shetani akimjaribu. Alikuwa kati ya wanyama wa porini, na malaika wakamhudumia.
sw.R: Yesu alikaa jangwani siku arobaini, na Shetani alijaribu kumfanya atende dhambi. Wanyama wa porini walikuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, na malaika walimtunza.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} esteve no deserto quarenta dias, sendo tentado por Satanás, e estava com as feras, e os anjos {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} serviam.
pt.B: Ele ficou no deserto quarenta dias, enquanto Satanás {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tentava. Estava no meio dos animais selvagens, e os anjos cuidavam {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.R: Jesus ficou no deserto durante quarenta dias, e Satanás tentou levá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} a fazer o que é errado. Havia animais selvagens lá com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, e anjos cuidavam {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: በምድረ በዳም አርባ ቀን በሰይጣን እየተፈተነ ነበረ፤ ከአራዊትም ጋር ነበረ፤ መላእክትም ያገለግሉት ነበር።
am.B: በምድረ በዳ አርባ ቀን ቆየ፤ በዚያም ሰይጣን ፈተነው። በአራዊት መካከል ነበረ፤ መላእክትም ተንከባከቡት።
am.R: ኢየሱስ በበረሃ አርባ ቀን ቆየ፤ ሰይጣንም ስሕተት እንዲሠራ ሊገፋፋው ሞከረ። የዱር አራዊትም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ፤ መላእክትም ይንከባከቡት ነበር።

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был в пустыне сорок дней, искушаемый сатаной, и был с дикими зверями, и ангелы служили {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.
ru.B: Он пробыл в пустыне сорок дней, и сатана искушал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Он был среди диких зверей, и ангелы заботились о {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}}.
ru.R: Иисус был в пустыне сорок дней, и сатана пытался заставить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} согрешить. Там с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} были дикие звери, и ангелы заботились о {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}}.

hi.L: और वे चालीस दिन निर्जन प्रदेश में रहे, और शैतान उनकी परीक्षा करता रहा; और वे जंगली पशुओं के साथ थे, और स्वर्गदूत उनकी सेवा करते थे।
hi.B: वे चालीस दिन निर्जन प्रदेश में रहे, और उस समय शैतान उनकी परीक्षा करता रहा। वे जंगली जानवरों के बीच थे, और स्वर्गदूत उनकी देखभाल करते थे।
hi.R: यीशु चालीस दिन सुनसान इलाक़े में रहे, और शैतान उनसे पाप करवाने की कोशिश करता रहा। वहाँ जंगली जानवर उनके साथ थे, और स्वर्गदूत उनकी देखभाल करते थे।

uk.L: І був у пустелі сорок днів, спокушуваний сатаною, і був із дикими звірами, і ангели служили {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.
uk.B: Сорок днів {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} пробув у пустелі, і сатана спокушав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. Він був серед диких звірів, і ангели дбали про {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.
uk.R: Ісус був у пустелі сорок днів, і сатана намагався змусити {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} згрішити. Поруч із {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} були дикі звірі, а ангели дбали про {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.

ja.L: そしてイエスは四十日の間、荒れ野におられ、サタンから誘惑を受けておられた。そして野の獣たちと共におられた。そして天使たちがイエスに仕えていた。
ja.B: イエスは四十日間荒れ野にとどまって、サタンから誘惑を受けられた。イエスは野の獣たちと共におられ、天使たちがイエスに仕えていた。
ja.R: イエスは四十日間、荒れ野におられました。その間、サタンはイエスに悪いことをさせようとしました。そこには野の獣たちもいましたが、天使たちがイエスのお世話をしました。

id.L: Dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berada di padang gurun empat puluh hari, dicobai oleh Satan, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berada bersama binatang-binatang liar, dan malaikat-malaikat melayani-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.
id.B: Dia tinggal di padang gurun empat puluh hari lamanya, sementara Satan mencobai-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. Dia berada di antara binatang-binatang liar, dan malaikat-malaikat melayani-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.
id.R: Yesus berada di padang gurun selama empat puluh hari, dan Satan berusaha membuat-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} berbuat dosa. Binatang-binatang liar ada di sana bersama-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, dan malaikat-malaikat melayani-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.

zh.L: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在旷野四十天，受撒但的试探；{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}和野兽在一起，天使们一直服侍{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。
zh.B: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在旷野待了四十天，撒但试探{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}与野兽在一起，天使们照顾{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。
zh.R: 耶稣在荒野住了四十天，撒但引诱{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}做错事。那里有野兽和{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}在一起，天使们照顾{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。

fa.L: و چهل روز در بیابان بود و شیطان او را وسوسه می‌کرد، و با جانوران وحشی بود، و فرشتگان او را خدمت می‌کردند.
fa.B: او چهل روز در بیابان ماند و در این مدت شیطان او را وسوسه می‌کرد. او در میان جانوران وحشی بود و فرشتگان از او مراقبت می‌کردند.
fa.R: عیسی چهل روز در بیابان بود و شیطان می‌کوشید او را به کار بد وادارد. جانوران وحشی آن‌جا با او بودند و فرشتگان از او مراقبت می‌کردند.

ar.L: وكان في البرّيّة أربعين يومًا يجرّبه الشيطان، وكان مع الوحوش، والملائكة كانوا يخدمونه.
ar.B: وبقي في البرّيّة أربعين يومًا والشيطان يجرّبه. وكان بين الحيوانات البرّيّة، وكانت الملائكة تعتني به.
ar.R: بقي يسوع في الصحراء أربعين يومًا، والشيطان يحاول أن يوقعه في الخطيئة. وكانت الحيوانات البرّيّة معه هناك، والملائكة تعتني به.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਚਾਲੀ ਦਿਨ ਉਜਾੜ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਨ, ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ੈਤਾਨ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਰਤਾਉਂਦਾ ਰਿਹਾ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਜੰਗਲੀ ਜਾਨਵਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਸਨ, ਅਤੇ ਦੂਤ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਸਨ।
pa.B: ਉਹ ਚਾਲੀ ਦਿਨ ਉਜਾੜ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹੇ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ੈਤਾਨ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ਲਈ। ਉਹ ਜੰਗਲੀ ਜਾਨਵਰਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਸਨ, ਅਤੇ ਦੂਤਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਕੀਤੀ।
pa.R: ਯਿਸੂ ਚਾਲੀ ਦਿਨ ਸੁੰਨਸਾਨ ਥਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹੇ, ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ੈਤਾਨ ਨੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਗ਼ਲਤ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕੀਤੀ। ਉੱਥੇ ਜੰਗਲੀ ਜਾਨਵਰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਸਨ, ਅਤੇ ਦੂਤ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਨ।

decisions.choice: tempted: put to the test, here by one who wants him to fail
alternatives: only tested to show his strength
decisions.reason: The word covers both testing and temptation. Satan's aim is to make Jesus turn from God's way.

decisions.choice: Satan: the adversary, the enemy of God
decisions.reason: The name means accuser or adversary. Matthew and Luke call him the devil in this story.

decisions.choice: forty days: Israel's forty years, and the forty days of Moses and Elijah
decisions.reason: Israel was tested for forty years in the wilderness. Moses was on the mountain forty days (Exodus 34:28), and Elijah walked forty days to Horeb (1 Kings 19:8).

decisions.choice: with the wild animals: in dangerous, empty country
alternatives: at peace with the animals, as in Isaiah 11:6-9
decisions.reason: Mark does not say what the animals mean. They show how wild the place was; some read them as a sign of the peace of God's new age.

decisions.choice: were serving him: caring for his needs
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of Simon's mother-in-law in 1:31. Angels brought Elijah food in the wilderness (1 Kings 19:5-7).

decisions.choice: tried to make him do wrong
decisions.reason: Readable says what tempting means in plain words, as in Matthew 4:1.

decisions.choice: "시험을 받으셨다" (L, B)
decisions.reason: "시험" covers both testing and tempting, as the Greek word does (meaning decision); "유혹" names only the enticement. Readable says what Satan tried to do, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "በሰይጣን እየተፈተነ" (being tested by Satan, L); "ሰይጣን ፈተነው" (B); "ስሕተት እንዲሠራ ሊገፋፋው ሞከረ" (tried to push him to do wrong, R)
decisions.reason: Mark names the adversary "Satan", so Amharic says "ሰይጣን" and keeps "ዲያብሎስ" for the Greek word for the devil. "መፈተን" covers both testing and tempting; Readable says what the testing aimed at, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "शैतान उनकी परीक्षा करता रहा" (L)
decisions.reason: A Hindi passive with an agent ("शैतान के द्वारा परखे जाते हुए") is stiff, so Literal makes Satan the subject and keeps the ongoing sense of the participle with "करता रहा".

decisions.choice: "誘惑を受ける" (L, B); "悪いことをさせようとした" (R)
decisions.reason: The word covers both testing and temptation, but Satan's aim is to make Jesus fail (m1), so Japanese says "誘惑", the word the other New Testament books use. Readable says what tempting means in plain words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Satan" for satanas
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets (section 7): "Satan" for satanas, "Iblis" for diabolos, and lowercase "setan" only for demons at Literal.

decisions.choice: "撒但"; "试探" (L, B); "引诱……做错事" (R)
decisions.reason: The glossary's forms, as at Matthew 4:1: "撒但" is the Bibles' spelling; Readable says what tempting means.

decisions.choice: "يجرّبه" (L, B), "يحاول أن يوقعه في الخطيئة" (R); "الشيطان" for satanas
decisions.reason: The glossary's "جرّب" covers testing and tempting (m1); Readable says what Satan wants. "الشيطان" is the glossary's word for satanas (m2).

decisions.choice: "ਸ਼ੈਤਾਨ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਰਤਾਉਂਦਾ ਰਿਹਾ" (L)
decisions.reason: The participle is continuous.

source.text: Καὶ μετὰ τὸ παραδοθῆναι τὸν Ἰωάννην ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ λέγων ὅτι Πεπλήρωται ὁ καιρὸς καὶ ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ· μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: And after the to be handed over the John came the Jesus into the Galilee proclaiming the gospel of the God \v 15 and saying, Has been fulfilled the time and has come near the kingdom of the God; repent and believe in the gospel.

en.L: And after John was handed over, Jesus came into Galilee, proclaiming the gospel of God \v 15 and saying, "The time has been fulfilled, and the kingdom of God has come near; repent and believe in the gospel."
en.B: After John had been handed over, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming God's gospel. \v 15 "The appointed time has arrived in full," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "and the kingdom of God has come near. Repent, and believe in the gospel."
en.R: After John was put in prison, Jesus went to Galilee and told people the good news from God. \v 15 He said, "The time God promised has come. The kingdom of God is coming near. Turn away from your sins and come back to God, and believe the good news!"

vi.L: Và sau khi Giăng bị nộp, Đức Giê-xu đến Ga-li-lê, rao giảng Tin Lành của Đức Chúa Trời \v 15 và nói rằng: "Thời kỳ đã được trọn, và vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đã đến gần; hãy ăn năn và tin vào Tin Lành."
vi.B: Sau khi Giăng bị bắt nộp, Đức Giê-xu đi đến Ga-li-lê, rao giảng Tin Lành của Đức Chúa Trời. \v 15 Ngài nói: "Thời kỳ đã định nay đã đến trọn, và vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đã đến gần. Hãy ăn năn và tin vào Tin Lành."
vi.R: Sau khi Giăng bị bỏ tù, Đức Giê-xu đi đến miền Ga-li-lê và nói cho người ta biết Tin Lành từ Đức Chúa Trời. \v 15 Ngài nói: "Thời điểm Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa nay đã đến. Vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đang đến gần. Hãy từ bỏ tội lỗi, quay về với Đức Chúa Trời, và hãy tin nhận Tin Lành!"

ko.L: 그리고 요한이 넘겨진 뒤에 예수께서 갈릴리로 오셔서 하나님의 복음을 선포하시며 \v 15 말씀하셨다. "그 때가 채워졌고 하나님의 나라가 가까이 다가왔다. 회개하여라. 그리고 복음을 믿어라."
ko.B: 요한이 잡혀 넘겨진 뒤에 예수께서 갈릴리로 가셔서 하나님의 복음을 선포하셨다. \v 15 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "하나님께서 정하신 때가 이제 다 찼다. 하나님의 나라가 가까이 와 있다. 회개하고 복음을 믿어라."
ko.R: 요한이 감옥에 갇힌 뒤에 예수께서 갈릴리로 가셔서, 하나님께서 주신 기쁜 소식을 사람들에게 전하셨다. \v 15 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "하나님께서 약속하신 때가 왔다. 하나님의 나라가 가까이 오고 있다. 죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오너라. 그리고 이 기쁜 소식을 믿어라!"

es.L: Y después de que Juan fue entregado, vino Jesús a Galilea proclamando el evangelio de Dios \v 15 y diciendo: «El tiempo se ha cumplido, y el reino de Dios se ha acercado; {{plural_you:arrepiéntanse|arrepentíos}} y {{plural_you:crean|creed}} en el evangelio».
es.B: Después de que Juan fue entregado, Jesús fue a Galilea a proclamar el evangelio de Dios. \v 15 «Ha llegado el tiempo señalado —decía—, y el reino de Dios se ha acercado. {{plural_you:Arrepiéntanse|Arrepentíos}} y {{plural_you:crean|creed}} en el evangelio».
es.R: Después de que metieron a Juan en la cárcel, Jesús fue a Galilea y anunciaba la buena noticia que viene de Dios. \v 15 Decía: «Ha llegado el tiempo que Dios prometió. El reino de Dios está cerca. {{plural_you:Apártense|Apartaos}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados y {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a Dios, y {{plural_you:crean|creed}} la buena noticia».

fr.L: Et après que Jean eut été livré, Jésus vint en Galilée, proclamant l’Évangile de Dieu \v 15 et disant : « Le temps est accompli, et le royaume de Dieu s’est approché ; repentez-vous et croyez en l’Évangile. »
fr.B: Après que Jean eut été livré, Jésus alla en Galilée, où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} proclamait l’Évangile de Dieu. \v 15 « Le temps fixé est pleinement arrivé, disait-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}, et le royaume de Dieu est tout proche. Repentez-vous, et croyez à l’Évangile. »
fr.R: Après que Jean a été mis en prison, Jésus est allé en Galilée. Il annonçait aux gens la bonne nouvelle qui vient de Dieu. \v 15 Il disait : « Le moment que Dieu avait promis est arrivé. Le royaume de Dieu est tout proche. Détournez-vous de vos péchés et revenez à Dieu, et croyez à la bonne nouvelle ! »

sw.L: Na baada ya Yohana kukabidhiwa, Yesu alikuja Galilaya, akihubiri Injili ya Mungu \v 15 na kusema, "Muda umetimizwa, na ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia; tubuni na mwamini katika Injili."
sw.B: Baada ya Yohana kukabidhiwa na kutiwa nguvuni, Yesu alikwenda Galilaya, akihubiri Injili ya Mungu. \v 15 Alisema, "Wakati uliowekwa umewadia kikamilifu, na ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia. Tubuni, mkaiamini Injili."
sw.R: Baada ya Yohana kufungwa gerezani, Yesu alikwenda Galilaya, akawaambia watu Habari Njema kutoka kwa Mungu. \v 15 Alisema, "Wakati ambao Mungu aliahidi umefika. Ufalme wa Mungu umekaribia. Acheni dhambi zenu, mrudieni Mungu, na muiamini Habari Njema!"

pt.L: E, depois que João foi entregue, Jesus veio para a Galileia, pregando o evangelho de Deus \v 15 e dizendo: "O tempo se cumpriu, e o Reino de Deus se aproximou; arrependam-se e creiam no evangelho."
pt.B: Depois que João foi entregue, Jesus foi para a Galileia, proclamando o evangelho de Deus. \v 15 "O tempo marcado se cumpriu", disse {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, "e o Reino de Deus está próximo. Arrependam-se e creiam no evangelho."
pt.R: Depois que João foi posto na prisão, Jesus foi para a Galileia e contava às pessoas as boas-novas que vêm de Deus. \v 15 Ele dizia: "Chegou o tempo que Deus prometeu. O Reino de Deus está chegando. Abandonem os seus pecados e voltem para Deus, e acreditem nas boas-novas!"

am.L: ዮሐንስም ተላልፎ ከተሰጠ በኋላ ኢየሱስ የእግዚአብሔርን ወንጌል እየሰበከ ወደ ገሊላ መጣ፤ \v 15 እንዲህም ይል ነበር፦ «ዘመኑ ተፈጸመ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ቀርባለች፤ ንስሓ ግቡ፤ በወንጌልም እመኑ።»
am.B: ዮሐንስ ተላልፎ ከተሰጠ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ሄደ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ወንጌል ያውጅ ነበር። \v 15 «የተወሰነው ጊዜ ፍጹም ደርሷል» አለ፤ «የእግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ቀርባለች። ንስሓ ግቡ፤ በወንጌልም እመኑ።»
am.R: ዮሐንስ ወደ እስር ቤት ከተጣለ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ሄደ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር የመጣውንም የምሥራች ለሰዎች ነገራቸው። \v 15 እንዲህም አለ፦ «እግዚአብሔር ተስፋ የሰጠው ጊዜ ደርሷል። የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እየቀረበች ነው። ኃጢአታችሁን ትታችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለሱ፤ የምሥራቹንም እመኑ!»

ru.L: И после того как Иоанн был передан [под стражу], пришёл Иисус в Галилею, проповедуя Евангелие Божье \v 15 и говоря: «Исполнилось время, и приблизилось Царство Божье; покайтесь и верьте в Евангелие.»
ru.B: После того как Иоанна арестовали, Иисус пришёл в Галилею и возвещал Божье Евангелие. \v 15 «Назначенное время настало», — говорил {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, — «и Царство Божье приблизилось. Покайтесь и верьте в Евангелие.»
ru.R: Когда Иоанна посадили в тюрьму, Иисус пошёл в Галилею и рассказывал людям Радостную весть от Бога. \v 15 Он говорил: «Пришло время, которое обещал Бог. Царство Божье уже близко. Оставьте свои грехи и вернитесь к Богу, и верьте Радостной вести!»

hi.L: और यूहन्ना के पकड़वाए जाने के बाद यीशु परमेश्वर के सुसमाचार का प्रचार करते हुए गलील में आए \v 15 और कहते थे, "समय पूरा हो गया है, और परमेश्वर का राज्य निकट आ पहुँचा है; मन फिराओ और सुसमाचार पर विश्वास करो।"
hi.B: यूहन्ना के पकड़वाए जाने के बाद यीशु गलील में आए और परमेश्वर के सुसमाचार का प्रचार करने लगे। \v 15 "ठहराया हुआ समय पूरा हो गया है," उन्होंने कहा, "और परमेश्वर का राज्य पास आ गया है। मन फिराओ और सुसमाचार पर विश्वास करो।"
hi.R: यूहन्ना को जेल में डाल दिए जाने के बाद यीशु गलील गए और लोगों को परमेश्वर का सुसमाचार सुनाने लगे। \v 15 उन्होंने कहा, "परमेश्वर का ठहराया हुआ समय आ गया है। परमेश्वर का राज्य पास आ रहा है। अपने पापों से मुड़ो और परमेश्वर की ओर लौट आओ, और सुसमाचार पर विश्वास करो!"

uk.L: А після того як Івана було видано, прийшов Ісус у Галилею, проповідуючи Євангеліє Боже \v 15 і кажучи: «Сповнився час, і наблизилося Царство Боже; покайтеся і вірте в Євангеліє.»
uk.B: Після того як Івана видали, Ісус пішов у Галилею і проповідував Боже Євангеліє. \v 15 «Призначений час настав повністю», — казав {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}, — «і Царство Боже наблизилося. Покайтеся і вірте в Євангеліє.»
uk.R: Після того як Івана кинули у вʼязницю, Ісус пішов у Галилею і розповідав людям Добру звістку від Бога. \v 15 Він казав: «Настав час, який обіцяв Бог. Царство Боже вже близько. Відверніться від своїх гріхів, поверніться до Бога і повірте в Добру звістку!»

ja.L: そしてヨハネが引き渡された後、イエスはガリラヤへ来られ、神の福音を宣べ伝えて、\v 15 言われた。「時は満たされた。そして神の国は近づいている。悔い改めなさい。そして福音を信じなさい。」
ja.B: ヨハネが引き渡された後、イエスはガリラヤへ行かれ、神の福音を宣べ伝えられた。\v 15 「定められた時が、ついに満ちた」とイエスは言われた。「神の国はすぐそこまで来ている。悔い改めて、福音を信じなさい。」
ja.R: ヨハネが牢に入れられた後、イエスはガリラヤへ行かれ、神からの良い知らせを人々に伝えられました。\v 15 イエスは言われました。「神が約束された時が来た。神の国が近づいている。心を入れ替えて神に立ち返り、この良い知らせを信じなさい。」

id.L: Dan sesudah Yohanes diserahkan, Yesus datang ke Galilea, memberitakan Injil Allah \v 15 dan berkata, "Waktunya telah genap, dan Kerajaan Allah sudah dekat; bertobatlah dan percayalah kepada Injil."
id.B: Sesudah Yohanes diserahkan, Yesus pergi ke Galilea dan memberitakan Injil Allah. \v 15 "Waktu yang ditetapkan sudah genap," kata-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, "dan Kerajaan Allah sudah dekat. Bertobatlah, dan percayalah kepada Injil."
id.R: Sesudah Yohanes dimasukkan ke penjara, Yesus pergi ke Galilea dan memberitakan kabar baik dari Allah. \v 15 Dia berkata, "Waktu yang dijanjikan Allah sudah tiba. Kerajaan Allah sudah dekat. Berbaliklah dari dosa-dosa kalian dan kembalilah kepada Allah, dan percayalah kepada kabar baik itu!"

zh.L: 约翰被交出去以后，耶稣来到加利利，宣讲{{god_term:神|上帝}}的福音，\v 15 说：“时候已经满了，{{god_term:神|上帝}}的国已经临近了；你们要悔改，并且要信这福音。”
zh.B: 约翰被交出去以后，耶稣到了加利利，宣讲{{god_term:神|上帝}}的福音。\v 15 “所定的时候已经完全来到，”{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}说，“{{god_term:神|上帝}}的国已经临近了。你们要悔改，要信福音。”
zh.R: 约翰被关进监牢以后，耶稣到加利利去，把从{{god_term:神|上帝}}来的好消息告诉人们。\v 15 {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}说：“{{god_term:神|上帝}}应许的时候已经到了。{{god_term:神|上帝}}的国快要来到了。你们要离开罪，回到{{god_term:神|上帝}}身边，并且要相信这好消息！”

fa.L: و پس از آن‌که یحیی تسلیم شد، عیسی به جلیل آمد و انجیل خدا را اعلام می‌کرد \v 15 و می‌گفت: «زمان به کمال رسیده و ملکوت خدا نزدیک شده است؛ توبه کنید و به انجیل ایمان آورید.»
fa.B: پس از آن‌که یحیی تسلیم شد، عیسی به جلیل رفت و انجیل خدا را اعلام کرد. \v 15 گفت: «زمان مقرر به کمال رسیده است،» و افزود: «و ملکوت خدا نزدیک شده است. توبه کنید و به انجیل ایمان آورید.»
fa.R: پس از آن‌که یحیی را به زندان انداختند، عیسی به جلیل رفت و خبر خوش خدا را به مردم گفت. \v 15 او گفت: «زمانی که خدا وعده داده بود فرا رسیده است. پادشاهی خدا نزدیک می‌شود. از گناهانتان دست بکشید و به سوی خدا بازگردید و به این خبر خوش ایمان بیاورید!»

ar.L: وبعد أن أُسلم يوحنا، جاء يسوع إلى الجليل ينادي بإنجيل الله \v 15 ويقول: «قد تمّ الوقت، واقترب ملكوت الله. توبوا، وآمنوا بالإنجيل».
ar.B: وبعد أن أُسلم يوحنا، ذهب يسوع إلى الجليل ينادي بإنجيل الله. \v 15 وكان يقول: «حان الوقت المعيّن تمامًا، وملكوت الله قد صار قريبًا. توبوا، وآمنوا بالإنجيل».
ar.R: وبعد أن وُضع يوحنا في السجن، ذهب يسوع إلى الجليل، وأخذ يبشّر الناس بالبشارة التي من الله. \v 15 وكان يقول: «جاء الوقت الذي وعد به الله. ملكوت الله يقترب. اتركوا خطاياكم وارجعوا إلى الله، وصدّقوا البشارة!».

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਦੇ ਫੜਵਾਏ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਯਿਸੂ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਖ਼ਬਰੀ ਦਾ ਪਰਚਾਰ ਕਰਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਗਲੀਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਏ \v 15 ਅਤੇ ਆਖਦੇ ਸਨ, "ਸਮਾਂ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦਾ ਰਾਜ ਨੇੜੇ ਆ ਪਹੁੰਚਿਆ ਹੈ; ਤੋਬਾ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਖ਼ਬਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਸ਼ਵਾਸ ਕਰੋ।"
pa.B: ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਦੇ ਫੜਵਾਏ ਜਾਣ ਪਿੱਛੋਂ ਯਿਸੂ ਗਲੀਲ ਨੂੰ ਗਏ ਅਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੀ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਖ਼ਬਰੀ ਦਾ ਐਲਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਲੱਗੇ। \v 15 ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਮਿੱਥਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਮਾਂ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਆ ਪਹੁੰਚਿਆ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦਾ ਰਾਜ ਲਾਗੇ ਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਤੋਬਾ ਕਰੋ, ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਖ਼ਬਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਸ਼ਵਾਸ ਰੱਖੋ।"
pa.R: ਜਦੋਂ ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਨੂੰ ਕੈਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ, ਤਾਂ ਯਿਸੂ ਗਲੀਲ ਨੂੰ ਗਏ ਅਤੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਖ਼ਬਰੀ ਸੁਣਾਈ। \v 15 ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਉਹ ਸਮਾਂ ਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਨੇ ਵਾਇਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੀ। ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦਾ ਰਾਜ ਨੇੜੇ ਆ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ। ਆਪਣੇ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਮੁੜੋ ਅਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਵੱਲ ਵਾਪਸ ਆਓ, ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਖ਼ਬਰੀ ਉੱਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਵਾਸ ਕਰੋ!"

alignments.target_span: すぐそこまで来ている

decisions.choice: handed over: arrested and put in prison
decisions.reason: Mark tells of John's arrest in 6:17. The same verb is used of Jesus being handed over (9:31; 14:41) and then of his followers (13:9), so John's path foreshadows theirs.

decisions.choice: the gospel of God: the good news that comes from God
decisions.reason: God is the source of the news. Its content is what Jesus says next: God's kingdom has come near.

decisions.choice: the time has been fulfilled: the time God set has fully come
alternatives: time in general has run out
decisions.reason: The word for time is the appointed moment. What the prophets waited for has arrived.

decisions.choice: has come near: it is close at hand, already pressing in
decisions.reason: The perfect tense says the kingdom has drawn near and is now close. Matthew 4:17 has the same verb. God's rule is breaking in through Jesus' words and works.

decisions.choice: believe in the gospel: trust the message and rely on it
decisions.reason: Believing "in" a message is an unusual phrase. It means putting one's trust in the news that God's kingdom has come near.

decisions.choice: was put in prison
decisions.reason: Readable says what being handed over meant for John, which Mark tells in 6:17.

decisions.choice: turn away from your sins and come back to God
decisions.reason: Readable says what repenting means, as in Matthew 3:2 and 4:17.

decisions.choice: "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời" for the kingdom of God
decisions.reason: As in John 3:3-5: "nước" is the traditional word but today reads first as "country"; "vương quốc" keeps the idea of God's rule as king. Used through Mark.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 나라" at every level, through Mark
decisions.reason: As John 3:3 in Korean. "나라" covers both God's reign and the realm where it holds; "천국" (heaven) would suggest a place after death, which is not what Jesus announces here.

decisions.choice: Jesus speaks in 해라체 ("믿어라", "오너라"), through Mark
decisions.reason: The style guide fixes this for the Gospels: Jesus speaks plainly to crowds, disciples and opponents, and people speak to him in 합쇼체, so relationships do not shift between scenes.

decisions.choice: el reino de Dios
decisions.reason: As in John 3:3 and Galatians 5:21, with a lower-case "reino". The same words at every level and throughout Mark.

decisions.choice: fue entregado
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb "hand over", which Mark uses again of Jesus (9:31; 14:41; 15:1); meaning decision m1 says it means arrest, which Readable spells out.

decisions.choice: repentez-vous (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Se repentir" is the French word for the turning the Greek verb describes, and it matches "repentance" in 1:4. "Se convertir" now suggests changing religion. Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: croyez en (L); croyez à (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal follows the Greek preposition. "Croire à" is the ordinary French for trusting that a message is true (meaning decision m5).

decisions.choice: kukabidhiwa (L); kukabidhiwa na kutiwa nguvuni (B); kufungwa gerezani (R)
decisions.reason: Mark's verb "to hand over" is "kukabidhi(wa)" at Literal and Balanced throughout the book, wherever John, Jesus or the Son of Man is handed over (9:31; 10:33; 14:41; 15:1-15), so the link the meaning decision points out stays visible. Judas's act may be "kusaliti" (betray) at Balanced and Readable (3:19; 14:10-11, 18, 21, 42-44). Here Balanced adds that John was arrested, "kutiwa nguvuni", and Readable that he was put in prison, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: Acheni dhambi zenu, mrudieni Mungu (R); tubuni (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Kutubu" is the established word for repentance; Readable says what it means, leaving sin and coming back to God, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት" (the kingdom of God) at every level
decisions.reason: "መንግሥት" means both the reign of a king and the realm he rules, the two senses of the Greek. The plain Amharic phrase reads at every level; Mark's phrase is the kingdom of God, not Matthew's kingdom of heaven. Used through Mark.

decisions.choice: "ንስሓ ግቡ" (repent, L, B); "ኃጢአታችሁን ትታችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለሱ" (leave your sins and come back to God, R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew: "ንስሓ ግቡ" is the living word for turning back to God, and Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. "ተጸጸቱ" would say only that they feel regret.

decisions.choice: 'был передан [под стражу]'
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 4:12: 'предан' would mean betrayed. Literal keeps 'handed over' and brackets what Russian needs to make it an arrest.

decisions.choice: 'Царство Божье'
decisions.reason: The term this translation uses for God's rule at every level, with the modern form 'Божье'.

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर का राज्य" at every level
decisions.reason: The book's key term for the kingdom of God, the same at every level, as "स्वर्ग का राज्य" is in Matthew.

decisions.choice: "पकड़वाए जाने" (L, B); "जेल में डाल दिए जाने" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek "handed over" is kept at Literal and Balanced with "पकड़वाना", which says that someone delivered him up; Readable says what it meant for John, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Відверніться від своїх гріхів, поверніться до Бога"
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what repenting means, as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced keep "покайтеся".

decisions.choice: "引き渡された" (L, B); "牢に入れられた" (R)
alternatives: "捕らえられた" at every level
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the verb Mark later uses of Jesus and his followers being handed over (m1), so the link stays visible. Readable says what it meant for John, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "心を入れ替えて神に立ち返り" (R)
alternatives: "悔い改めなさい" at Readable too
