alignments.target_span: 何の関わりがあるのか

decisions.choice: with an unclean spirit: in the power of an unclean spirit
alternatives: a man who had a bad attitude
decisions.reason: "In a spirit" means held under the spirit's power. The spirit speaks through the man.

decisions.choice: an unclean spirit: an evil spirit, a demon
decisions.reason: Mark calls these beings both unclean spirits and demons (1:34; 3:22, 30). "Unclean" sets them against the Holy Spirit (1:8) and the Holy One of God (1:24).

decisions.choice: what to us and to you: what do we have in common? leave us alone
alternatives: what do you want from us, a friendly question
decisions.reason: The phrase keeps someone at a distance (Judges 11:12; 1 Kings 17:18). Here it is hostile.

decisions.choice: us: the spirit speaks for all the unclean spirits
alternatives: the man and the spirit together
decisions.reason: The spirit speaks for its kind, which Jesus has come to defeat (3:27).

decisions.choice: an evil spirit
decisions.reason: Readable says "evil", since "unclean" suggests dirt to new readers.

decisions.choice: "linh ô uế" (L, B); "tà linh" (R) for the unclean spirit (whole book)
decisions.reason: Lowercase "linh" for a spirit that is not the Holy Spirit, with "ô uế" for Mark's "unclean", the same word Mark uses for ritual uncleanness (7:2, 7:15); "uế linh" is a compound few readers know. Readable uses the plainer "tà linh" (evil spirit), as the English Readable does. "quỷ" is kept for "demon" (1:32-39).

decisions.choice: the spirit says "Giê-xu" without "Đức", "ông" for "you" and "chúng tôi" for itself
decisions.reason: A hostile speaker does not honour Jesus, as the arresting party in John 18:5; "ông" is the word for a man one does not honour, and words of address take no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "더러운 영" (L, B), "악한 영" (R), through Mark; "더러운 영에 [사로잡힌]" (L), "영이 들린" (B)
decisions.reason: "영" keeps Mark's word "spirit" and "더러운" keeps "unclean"; "귀신" is kept for the Greek word for demon (1:32-39). Readable says "악한 영", as the English Readable says "evil spirit". Literal brackets the verb Korean needs for "in a spirit" (in its power, meaning decision); Balanced uses the idiom "들리다" (be possessed).

decisions.choice: the unclean spirit speaks to Jesus in 합쇼체, with "당신", "나" / "우리" for itself and no honorific -시- or "께" for him, through Mark (1:24; 3:11; 5:7-12)
decisions.reason: The style guide gives 합쇼체 for those who speak to Jesus and allows 해라체 for open opponents. The spirit both resists Jesus and fears him; formal endings with the cool "당신" and no honorific -시- keep that distance, as the envoys' questioning does in John 1:19-25. Every unclean spirit or demon that speaks to Jesus in Mark keeps this one level (1:24; 3:11; 5:7-12), so the scenes agree; a reviewer who prefers another level changes them together.

decisions.choice: espíritu impuro (L, B); espíritu maligno (R)
decisions.reason: "Impuro" keeps the Greek word's sense of being unfit for God's presence (meaning decision m2); "inmundo" is the traditional word but now sounds like dirt. Readable says "maligno", as the English says "evil". Throughout Mark.

decisions.choice: un esprit impur (L, B); un esprit mauvais (R), for the whole book
decisions.reason: "Impur" is the plain modern word for the Greek adjective, unclean in the sense of the law; "immonde" is old-fashioned. Readable says what such a spirit is, as the English Readable does (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: sous [l’emprise d’] (L); Quoi [de commun entre] nous et toi (L); Que nous veux-tu ? (B)
decisions.reason: French needs words the Greek leaves out to say "in [the power of] a spirit" (meaning decision m1) and "what to us and to you"; Literal brackets them. Balanced uses the French idiom "Que nous veux-tu ?", which carries the hostile "leave us alone" of the Greek (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: pepo mchafu (L, B); pepo mbaya (R), with personal agreement
decisions.reason: Mark has two words, "unclean spirit" and "demon" (1:32, 1:34). Swahili says "pepo mchafu" for the unclean spirit and plain "pepo" for the demon, as the Swahili of Matthew, Luke and Acts does: the same kind of being, and "roho" is kept for the Holy Spirit and the human spirit. "Pepo" takes personal agreement ("mchafu", plural "pepo wachafu") because a spirit being is meant. Readable says "pepo mbaya" (evil spirit), as the English Readable says "evil spirit". Used through Mark. For review by a native speaker.

decisions.choice: Mnazareti (L); wa Nazareti (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in John 18:5: "Mnazareti" is the Swahili word for a man of Nazareth and keeps the single word of the Greek at Literal.

decisions.choice: Jésus le Nazarénien (L); Jésus de Nazareth (B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark's own form of the name (also 10:47, 14:67, 16:6) is an adjective, "the Nazarene". Literal keeps the form as "le Nazarénien", as in the rest of Mark; Balanced and Readable say where he comes from, which is what it means.

decisions.choice: tu, ti
decisions.reason: Everyone who speaks to Jesus uses "tu", his opponents and the spirits too (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); the hostility is in the words (m3), not in the form of address.

decisions.choice: "ርኩስ መንፈስ" (unclean spirit, L, B); "ክፉ መንፈስ" (evil spirit, R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew: "ርኩስ" keeps the law's language of uncleanness; Readable says "ክፉ መንፈስ", as the English Readable says "evil spirit". The spirit says "አንተ" to Jesus, as everyone does. Used through Mark.

decisions.choice: 'Назарянин' (L); 'из Назарета' (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional title formed from the place name; Balanced and Readable say plainly where Jesus came from.

decisions.choice: "अशुद्ध आत्मा" (L, B); "बुरी आत्मा" (R), through Mark
decisions.reason: Readable says "evil", as the English does and as Matthew's Hindi Readable does, since "अशुद्ध" suggests dirt to a new reader. The spirit takes feminine agreement ("निकल गई"), as "आत्मा" does in Hindi; the Holy Spirit takes masculine agreement where he acts as a person.

decisions.choice: "आप" from the spirit to Jesus
decisions.reason: Everyone who speaks to Jesus says "आप" in this translation, opponents included.

decisions.choice: "Назарянине" (vocative of "Назарянин")
decisions.reason: The Greek here is Nazarēnos, so "Назарянин" rather than "Назорей", as the style guide sets by the Greek word; Readable says "з Назарета".

decisions.choice: "злий дух" (R); "нечистий дух" (L, B)
decisions.reason: For young readers "нечистий" can sound like dirt rather than evil; Readable says what the spirit is, as the English Readable does. Used through the book.

decisions.choice: "汚れた霊" at Readable too
alternatives: "悪い霊", as the English Readable says "evil spirit"
decisions.reason: The shared Gospel terms keep "汚れた霊" at every level. In Japanese "汚れた" does not only suggest dirt: it is the ordinary word for ritual uncleanness, which sets the spirit against the Holy Spirit and the Holy One of God (m2).

decisions.choice: the spirit speaks to Jesus in the plain style ("あるのか", "知っている")
decisions.reason: The words are hostile and keep Jesus at a distance (m3), so the spirit speaks plainly, without respect. It still says "あなた", not a rude pronoun, since it knows who he is (1:24).

decisions.choice: "roh najis" (L, B); "roh jahat" (R)
decisions.reason: The glossary words for the unclean spirit, for the whole of Mark; demons are "setan" at Literal and "roh jahat" at Balanced and Readable. The spirit speaks to Jesus as "Engkau", with the deity_pronoun span inside a sentence, as everyone does in Mark (style guide section 5).

decisions.choice: "污灵" (L, B); "邪灵" (R)
decisions.reason: The glossary's words for an unclean spirit, as at Matthew 10:1. Readable says "邪灵", since "污" suggests dirt.

decisions.choice: the address "拿撒勒的耶稣" first (B, R)
alternatives: the address at the end, as at Literal
decisions.reason: Chinese puts a name used in address at the start of the speech; Literal keeps the Greek order.

decisions.choice: "روح پلید" (Literal, Balanced); "روح شریر" (Readable), through Mark
decisions.reason: The glossary's "روح پلید" for an unclean spirit; Readable says an evil spirit, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "تو" from the spirit to Jesus
decisions.reason: The spirit does not speak to Jesus with respect but in alarm; the style guide gives شما to those who come to him with respect, so the spirits say "تو" through Mark.

decisions.choice: "روح نجس" (L, B), "روح شرّير" (R); "ما لنا ولك" (L), "ماذا تريد منّا" (B)
decisions.reason: The glossary's forms for an unclean spirit (m2). "ما لنا ولك" is the Arabic of the same Hebrew idiom of distance (m3); Balanced and Readable say its hostile sense plainly.

decisions.choice: "ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ ਆਤਮਾ" (L, B); "ਬੁਰੀ ਆਤਮਾ" (R), through Mark, with feminine agreement ("ਨਿੱਕਲ ਗਈ")
decisions.reason: Evil spirits take ordinary feminine agreement; the Holy Spirit stays masculine (style §7).

decisions.choice: "ਤੁਸੀਂ" from the spirit to Jesus
decisions.reason: Style §5: people speaking to Jesus say ਤੁਸੀਂ.

pa.R: ਮੈਨੂੰ ਪਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕੌਣ ਹੋ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਦੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋ!"

decisions.choice: the Holy One of God: the one set apart and belonging to God
decisions.reason: The spirit, unclean, names Jesus as the one who is holy, belonging wholly to God (compare John 6:69).

decisions.choice: I know who you are: naming him to resist him
decisions.reason: Knowing and saying another's name was thought to give power over him. Jesus silences the spirit (1:25).

decisions.choice: "하나님의 거룩한 분"
decisions.reason: The title names Jesus as set apart and belonging to God (meaning decision); "분" is the respectful noun the title calls for even in the spirit's mouth, while "자" is old-fashioned and now slightly disparaging.

decisions.choice: Te conozco, [sé] quién eres
decisions.reason: The Greek says "I know you, who you are"; Spanish cannot hang the question on "conocer", so Literal supplies the verb "saber". "Te" opens the sentence and is written plain.

decisions.choice: Je te connais, [je sais] qui tu es
decisions.reason: The Greek says "I know you, who you are"; French cannot hang the question on "connaître", so Literal brackets the second verb.

decisions.choice: "神の聖なる者"
decisions.reason: The title names the one set apart and belonging to God (m1). "聖なる者" says that in plain words; the spirit, which is hostile, does not use the respectful "方".

decisions.choice: "قدّوس الله"
decisions.reason: The established Arabic for "the Holy One of God" (m1), at every level.

source.text: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων· Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And rebuked him the Jesus saying, Be silenced and come out of him.

en.L: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be silenced, and come out of him!"
en.B: Jesus ordered it sternly, "Silence! Come out of the man!"
en.R: Jesus spoke strongly to the evil spirit. He said, "Be quiet! Come out of the man!"

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu quở trách nó, nói rằng: "Hãy im đi, và ra khỏi người này!"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nghiêm khắc ra lệnh cho nó: "Im đi! Hãy ra khỏi người này!"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói mạnh mẽ với tà linh: "Im đi! Ra khỏi người này!"

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 그를 꾸짖으시며 말씀하셨다. "입을 다물고 그에게서 나와라!"
ko.B: 예수께서 그 영을 엄하게 꾸짖으셨다. "조용히 하여라! 그 사람에게서 나오너라!"
ko.R: 예수께서 그 악한 영에게 단호하게 말씀하셨다. "입 다물어라! 그 사람에게서 나와라!"

es.L: Y Jesús lo reprendió, diciendo: «¡Enmudece, y sal de él!».
es.B: Jesús le dio una orden tajante: «¡Silencio! ¡Sal de este hombre!».
es.R: Jesús le habló con dureza al espíritu maligno. Le dijo: «¡Cállate! ¡Sal de este hombre!».

fr.L: Et Jésus le reprit sévèrement, disant : « Tais-toi, et sors de lui ! »
fr.B: Jésus lui donna un ordre sévère : « Silence ! Sors de cet homme ! »
fr.R: Jésus a parlé durement à l’esprit mauvais. Il a dit : « Tais-toi ! Sors de cet homme ! »

sw.L: Na Yesu akamkemea, akisema, "Fumba kinywa, na utoke ndani yake!"
sw.B: Yesu akamwamuru kwa ukali, "Nyamaza! Mtoke mtu huyu!"
sw.R: Yesu akamwambia yule pepo mbaya kwa ukali, "Kaa kimya! Mtoke mtu huyu!"

pt.L: E Jesus o repreendeu, dizendo: "Cale-se e saia dele!"
pt.B: Jesus deu ao espírito uma ordem severa: "Silêncio! Saia do homem!"
pt.R: Jesus falou com dureza ao espírito mau. Ele disse: "Fique quieto! Saia do homem!"

am.L: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ ገሠጸው፦ «ዝም በል፤ ከእርሱም ውጣ!»
am.B: ኢየሱስም አጥብቆ አዘዘው፦ «ዝም በል! ከሰውየው ውጣ!»
am.R: ኢየሱስም ክፉውን መንፈስ በብርቱ ቃል ተናገረው፤ እንዲህም አለው፦ «ዝም በል! ከሰውየው ውጣ!»

ru.L: И пригрозил ему Иисус, говоря: «Умолкни и выйди из него!»
ru.B: Иисус строго приказал ему: «Молчи! Выйди из этого человека!»
ru.R: Иисус строго заговорил со нечистым духом. Он сказал: «Замолчи! Выйди из этого человека!»

hi.L: और यीशु ने यह कहते हुए उसे डाँटा, "चुप हो जाओ, और उसमें से निकल आओ!"
hi.B: यीशु ने उसे कड़ाई से आज्ञा दी, "चुप रहो! इस आदमी में से निकल जाओ!"
hi.R: यीशु ने उस बुरी आत्मा को कड़ाई से डाँटा। उन्होंने कहा, "चुप हो जाओ! इस आदमी में से निकल जाओ!"

uk.L: І суворо наказав йому Ісус, кажучи: «Замовкни і вийди з нього!»
uk.B: Ісус суворо наказав йому: «Мовчи! Вийди з цього чоловіка!»
uk.R: Ісус суворо заговорив до злого духа. Він сказав: «Замовкни! Вийди з чоловіка!»

ja.L: そしてイエスは彼を叱って言われた。「黙れ。そして彼から出て行け。」
ja.B: イエスは霊を厳しく叱って言われた。「黙れ。この人から出て行け。」
ja.R: イエスは汚れた霊を強く叱って、言われました。「静かにしろ。この人から出て行け。」

id.L: Dan Yesus menghardiknya, katanya, "Diam, dan keluarlah dari dia!"
id.B: Yesus memerintahnya dengan keras, "Diam! Keluar dari orang ini!"
id.R: Yesus berbicara dengan keras kepada roh jahat itu. Dia berkata, "Diam! Keluar dari orang ini!"

zh.L: 耶稣斥责他，说：“住口，从他里面出来！”
zh.B: 耶稣严厉地命令它：“住口！从这人身上出来！”
zh.R: 耶稣严厉地对那邪灵说：“安静！从这个人身上出来！”

fa.L: و عیسی او را نهیب زد و گفت: «خاموش شو و از او بیرون بیا!»
fa.B: عیسی با تندی به او فرمان داد: «ساکت! از آن مرد بیرون بیا!»
fa.R: عیسی با تندی با روح شریر سخن گفت. او گفت: «ساکت شو! از این مرد بیرون بیا!»

ar.L: فانتهره يسوع وقال: «اخرس، واخرج منه!».
ar.B: فأمره يسوع بحزم: «اصمت! اخرج من الرجل!».
ar.R: فكلّم يسوع الروح الشرّير بشدّة، وقال: «اسكت! اخرج من الرجل!».

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਝਿੜਕਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਆਖਿਆ, "ਚੁੱਪ ਕਰ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲ ਜਾ!"
pa.B: ਯਿਸੂ ਨੇ ਸਖ਼ਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹੁਕਮ ਦਿੱਤਾ, "ਖ਼ਾਮੋਸ਼! ਇਸ ਆਦਮੀ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਬਾਹਰ ਨਿੱਕਲ!"
pa.R: ਯਿਸੂ ਨੇ ਬੁਰੀ ਆਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਕਰੜੇ ਬੋਲਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਚੁੱਪ ਹੋ ਜਾ! ਇਸ ਆਦਮੀ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲ ਆ!"

decisions.choice: rebuked: gave a stern command
decisions.reason: The word is used for Jesus' commands to spirits (3:12) and to the wind and sea (4:39). It is a word of power.

decisions.choice: be silenced: be muzzled, stop speaking
decisions.reason: The verb means to muzzle. Jesus will not let the spirit name him (1:34).

decisions.choice: him: the spirit is addressed; the man is the one it leaves
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the spirit and orders it out of the man.

decisions.choice: it; the man (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "it" for the spirit and "the man" for the one it is in, so that the two are not confused.

decisions.choice: "nó" for the spirit; commands with no pronoun; "người này" for the man
decisions.reason: The narrator speaks of the spirit as "nó", as of a thing without honour; Jesus' commands need no pronoun, so neither the archaic "ngươi" nor a choice of relation is forced.

decisions.choice: "입을 다물어라" (L, R), "조용히 하여라" (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek means "be muzzled" (meaning decision); "입을 다물다" keeps the picture of the mouth shut. "잠잠하라" is the older Bible form.

decisions.choice: enmudece
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is passive, "be muzzled" (meaning decision m2); "enmudecer" keeps the sense of being silenced better than the everyday "cállate".

decisions.choice: le reprit ... sors de lui (L)
decisions.reason: French "esprit" is masculine, so Literal's "le" and "lui" can stand, like the Greek, for the spirit and for the man (meaning decision m3); Balanced and Readable name the man.

decisions.choice: Fumba kinywa (L); Nyamaza (B); Kaa kimya (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is "be muzzled" (meaning decision); Literal keeps the picture with "shut your mouth", the words Literal uses again when Jesus speaks to the sea (4:39); the other levels say "be quiet".

decisions.choice: ao espírito
decisions.reason: Portuguese has no neuter "it": "o" could mean the man as well as the spirit. Balanced names the spirit, as the English decision does with "it" and "the man".

decisions.choice: "ዝም በል" (be silent) at every level
alternatives: "አፍህ ይዘጋ" (let your mouth be shut, L)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb pictures a muzzle. Amharic "ዝም በል" is the sharp, ordinary command to stop speaking and carries the force of a rebuke; a word-for-word passive would sound like a curse rather than a command. The spirit is addressed with the masculine "አንተ", since "መንፈስ" is masculine.

decisions.choice: 'пригрозил'
decisions.reason: The verb is a stern command. 'Запретил' today means only to forbid; 'пригрозил' keeps the sternness.

decisions.choice: "तुम" form ("चुप हो जाओ") from Jesus to the spirit
decisions.reason: Jesus says "तुम" to anyone he addresses in this translation, as to Satan at Matthew 4:10; the command itself carries the force.

decisions.choice: bare commands to the spirit ("黙れ", "出て行け")
alternatives: "黙りなさい", "出て行きなさい"
decisions.reason: Jesus' rebuke is a word of power over the spirit (m1, m2). Japanese gives a command of this kind in the bare imperative; the "〜なさい" Jesus uses to people would sound like advice here.

decisions.choice: "叱る" in kanji (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: Mark's verb for rebuking (1:25, 3:12, 4:39, 8:30, 8:32, 8:33, 9:25, 10:13, 10:48) is "叱る" at Literal every time, so a reader can follow it from the spirits and the storm to Peter. Balanced and Readable use "叱る" too, except where the sense is a strict order not to make Jesus known (3:12, 8:30: "厳しく命じる") and where Peter corrects his teacher (8:32). "叱" is a Jōyō kanji, so Readable writes it in kanji as well.

decisions.choice: "它" for the spirit; "这人" for the man (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chinese writes "它" for a spirit, which keeps it apart from the man it is in. Literal keeps "他" for both, as the Greek has one pronoun.

decisions.choice: "تو" ("خاموش شو", "ساکت شو") from Jesus to the spirit
decisions.reason: A command to one being; the singular at every level.

decisions.choice: "انتهره" (L), "أمره بحزم" (B); "اخرس" (L), "اصمت" (B), "اسكت" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is a stern command of power (m1), and "be muzzled" is harsh (m2): Literal's "اخرس" keeps the force, and Balanced and Readable soften it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ਤੂੰ" ("ਚੁੱਪ ਕਰ") from Jesus to the spirit
decisions.reason: Jesus says ਤੂੰ to one.

source.text: καὶ σπαράξαν αὐτὸν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον καὶ φωνῆσαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And having convulsed him the spirit the unclean and having cried with a voice loud it came out of him.

en.L: And the unclean spirit, throwing him into convulsions and crying out with a loud voice, came out of him.
en.B: The unclean spirit threw the man into a fit, gave a loud shriek, and left him.
en.R: The evil spirit made the man shake hard. Then it gave a loud scream and came out of him.

vi.L: Và linh ô uế, làm cho người ấy co giật và kêu lên một tiếng lớn, đã ra khỏi người ấy.
vi.B: Linh ô uế làm cho người ấy lên cơn co giật, rồi rú lên một tiếng lớn và ra khỏi người ấy.
vi.R: Tà linh làm cho người ấy run giật dữ dội. Rồi nó la lên một tiếng lớn và ra khỏi người ấy.

ko.L: 그러자 더러운 영이 그에게 경련을 일으키고 큰 소리로 외치며 그에게서 나왔다.
ko.B: 더러운 영은 그 사람에게 발작을 일으키고 크게 비명을 지르더니 그에게서 나왔다.
ko.R: 악한 영은 그 사람을 마구 뒤흔들었다. 그러고는 크게 소리를 지르며 그에게서 나왔다.

es.L: Y el espíritu impuro, sacudiéndolo con violencia y gritando a gran voz, salió de él.
es.B: El espíritu impuro sacudió al hombre con convulsiones, dio un fuerte alarido y salió de él.
es.R: El espíritu maligno hizo que el hombre se sacudiera con fuerza. Luego dio un grito muy fuerte y salió de él.

fr.L: Et l’esprit impur, l’ayant secoué de convulsions et ayant crié d’une voix forte, sortit de lui.
fr.B: L’esprit impur secoua l’homme avec violence, poussa un grand cri et sortit de lui.
fr.R: L’esprit mauvais a secoué l’homme très fort. Puis il a poussé un grand cri et il est sorti de lui.

sw.L: Na pepo mchafu, akimtikisa kwa nguvu na kupaza sauti kuu, akatoka ndani yake.
sw.B: Pepo mchafu akamtupatupa yule mtu kwa nguvu, akapiga ukelele mkubwa, akamtoka.
sw.R: Pepo mbaya akamtikisa yule mtu kwa nguvu. Kisha akapiga kelele kubwa, akatoka ndani yake.

pt.L: E o espírito impuro, sacudindo-o com convulsões e gritando em alta voz, saiu dele.
pt.B: O espírito impuro sacudiu o homem com violência, deu um grito forte e saiu dele.
pt.R: O espírito mau fez o homem tremer muito. Depois deu um grito forte e saiu dele.

am.L: ርኩሱ መንፈስም አንፈራግጦት በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኾ ከእርሱ ወጣ።
am.B: ርኩሱ መንፈስም ሰውየውን አንፈራግጦ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ፤ ከእርሱም ወጣ።
am.R: ክፉው መንፈስ ሰውየውን ክፉኛ አንቀጠቀጠው። ከዚያም በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ ከእርሱ ወጣ።

ru.L: И нечистый дух, сотрясши его и вскрикнув громким голосом, вышел из него.
ru.B: Нечистый дух забил человека в судорогах, громко закричал и вышел из него.
ru.R: Нечистый дух сильно затряс человека. Потом он громко закричал и вышел из него.

hi.L: और अशुद्ध आत्मा उसे मरोड़कर और ऊँची आवाज़ से चिल्लाकर उसमें से निकल गई।
hi.B: अशुद्ध आत्मा ने उस आदमी को झकझोरा, ज़ोर से चीखी, और उसमें से निकल गई।
hi.R: बुरी आत्मा ने उस आदमी को ज़ोर से हिलाया। फिर वह ज़ोर से चिल्लाई और उसमें से निकल गई।

uk.L: І нечистий дух, затрусивши ним і закричавши гучним голосом, вийшов із нього.
uk.B: Нечистий дух кинув чоловіка в судоми, голосно скрикнув і вийшов із нього.
uk.R: Злий дух сильно затряс чоловіка. Потім він голосно закричав і вийшов із нього.

ja.L: すると汚れた霊は彼をけいれんさせ、大きな声で叫んで、彼から出て行った。
ja.B: 汚れた霊はその人をひどくけいれんさせ、大きな叫び声を上げて出て行った。
ja.R: 汚れた霊は、その人の体を激しくふるわせました。そして大声で叫んで、その人から出て行きました。

id.L: Dan roh najis itu, sambil mengguncang-guncangkan dia dan berteriak dengan suara keras, keluar dari dia.
id.B: Roh najis itu membuat orang itu kejang-kejang, lalu menjerit dengan keras dan keluar darinya.
id.R: Roh jahat itu membuat orang itu terguncang-guncang dengan hebat. Lalu roh itu menjerit dengan keras dan keluar dari orang itu.

zh.L: 那污灵使他抽搐，又大声喊叫，就从他里面出来了。
zh.B: 污灵使那人一阵抽搐，尖叫一声，就离开了他。
zh.R: 邪灵使那个人剧烈地抖动。然后它大叫一声，从他身上出来了。

fa.L: و روح پلید او را به تشنج انداخت و با صدای بلند فریاد زد و از او بیرون آمد.
fa.B: روح پلید آن مرد را به تشنج انداخت، نعره‌ای بلند کشید و از او بیرون رفت.
fa.R: روح شریر آن مرد را سخت لرزاند. سپس با صدای بلند جیغ کشید و از او بیرون آمد.

ar.L: فصرعه الروح النجس، وصرخ بصوت عظيم، وخرج منه.
ar.B: فهزّ الروح النجس الرجل هزًّا عنيفًا، وأطلق صرخة عالية، وتركه.
ar.R: فجعل الروح الشرّير الرجل يرتجف بقوّة، ثمّ صرخ صرخة عالية، وخرج منه.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ ਆਤਮਾ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਰੋੜ ਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਵੱਡੀ ਅਵਾਜ਼ ਨਾਲ ਚੀਕ ਮਾਰ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲ ਗਈ।
pa.B: ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ ਆਤਮਾ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਆਦਮੀ ਨੂੰ ਦੌਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ, ਉੱਚੀ ਚੀਕ ਮਾਰੀ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਗਈ।
pa.R: ਬੁਰੀ ਆਤਮਾ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਆਦਮੀ ਨੂੰ ਜ਼ੋਰ ਨਾਲ ਹਿਲਾਇਆ। ਫਿਰ ਉਹ ਉੱਚੀ ਚੀਕ ਮਾਰ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਬਾਹਰ ਆ ਗਈ।

decisions.choice: throwing into convulsions: shaking him violently
decisions.reason: The word describes a violent fit (9:26). The man is not harmed in the end.

decisions.choice: crying out: the spirit's last protest as it obeys
decisions.reason: The spirit cries out but has to leave, which the crowd notices (1:27).

source.text: καὶ ἐθαμβήθησαν ἅπαντες, ὥστε συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντας· Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο;

records.literal_gloss: And were amazed all, so that to discuss with themselves saying, What is this?

en.L: And they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, "What is this?
en.B: Amazement seized them all, and they talked it over among themselves: "What is this?
en.R: All the people were amazed. They asked each other, "What is happening?

vi.L: Và tất cả đều kinh ngạc, đến nỗi họ hỏi nhau rằng: "Điều này là gì?
vi.B: Mọi người đều kinh ngạc, đến nỗi bàn tán với nhau: "Việc này là gì vậy?
vi.R: Mọi người đều sửng sốt. Họ hỏi nhau: "Chuyện gì đang xảy ra vậy?

ko.L: 그러자 모두가 크게 놀라서, 서로 논의하며 말하였다. "이것이 무엇이냐?
ko.B: 모두가 깜짝 놀라 서로 의논했다. "이게 어찌 된 일이냐?
ko.R: 사람들은 모두 놀랐다. 그들은 서로 물었다. "도대체 무슨 일이냐?

es.L: Y se asombraron todos, de modo que discutían entre sí, diciendo: «¿Qué es esto?
es.B: Todos quedaron asombrados y comentaban entre ellos: «¿Qué es esto?
es.R: Toda la gente estaba asombrada. Se preguntaban unos a otros: «¿Qué está pasando?

fr.L: Et tous furent saisis de stupeur, de sorte qu’ils se questionnaient entre eux, disant : « Qu’est-ce que ceci ?
fr.B: Tous furent saisis de stupeur et se mirent à discuter entre eux : « Qu’est-ce que cela ?
fr.R: Tout le monde était très étonné. Les gens se demandaient les uns aux autres : « Qu’est-ce qui se passe ?

sw.L: Na wote wakastaajabu, hata wakaulizana wao kwa wao, wakisema, "Hili ni nini?
sw.B: Wote walishangaa sana, wakajadiliana wao kwa wao: "Ni nini hiki?
sw.R: Watu wote walishangaa. Wakaulizana, "Ni nini kinatokea?

pt.L: E todos ficaram espantados, de modo que discutiam entre si, dizendo: "Que é isto?
pt.B: Todos ficaram tomados de espanto e comentavam entre si: "O que é isto?
pt.R: Todas as pessoas ficaram admiradas. Elas perguntavam umas às outras: "O que está acontecendo?

am.L: ሁሉም ተደነቁ፤ ስለዚህም እርስ በርሳቸው እንዲህ እያሉ ተጠያየቁ፦ «ይህ ምንድር ነው?
am.B: ሁሉም በመደነቅ ተያዙ፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም እንዲህ ተነጋገሩ፦ «ይህ ምንድር ነው?
am.R: ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ተደነቁ። እርስ በርሳቸውም እንዲህ ተባባሉ፦ «ምን እየሆነ ነው?

ru.L: И изумились все, так что спрашивали друг друга, говоря: «Что это?
ru.B: Все были поражены и стали обсуждать между собой: «Что это такое?
ru.R: Все люди удивились. Они спрашивали друг друга: «Что происходит?

hi.L: और सब चकित हुए, यहाँ तक कि वे आपस में यह कहते हुए विवाद करने लगे, "यह क्या है?
hi.B: सब पर आश्चर्य छा गया, और वे आपस में चर्चा करने लगे: "यह क्या है?
hi.R: सब लोग हैरान रह गए। वे एक-दूसरे से पूछने लगे, "यह क्या हो रहा है?

uk.L: І всі були вражені, так що розпитували між собою, кажучи: «Що це?
uk.B: Усіх охопив подив, і вони обговорювали між собою: «Що це таке?
uk.R: Усі люди дуже здивувалися. Вони питали одне одного: «Що тут відбувається?

ja.L: そして人々は皆ひどく驚き、そのため互いに論じ合って言った。「これは何なのか？
ja.B: 人々は皆、恐れと驚きに打たれて、互いに話し合った。「これはいったい何なのか？
ja.R: 人々はみな、とても驚きました。そして、おたがいに言い合いました。「何が起こっているのだろう？

id.L: Dan mereka semua takjub, sehingga mereka saling bertanya, katanya, "Apakah ini?
id.B: Semua orang tercengang, dan mereka saling membicarakannya: "Apa ini?
id.R: Semua orang heran. Mereka bertanya satu sama lain, "Apa yang sedang terjadi?

zh.L: 众人都惊奇，以致彼此议论说：“这是什么？
zh.B: 大家都十分惊讶，彼此议论：“这是什么？
zh.R: 所有的人都很惊奇。他们互相问：“发生了什么事？

fa.L: و همه در حیرت شدند، چنان‌که از یکدیگر می‌پرسیدند و می‌گفتند: «این چیست؟
fa.B: همه حیرت‌زده شدند و با یکدیگر گفت‌وگو می‌کردند: «این چیست؟
fa.R: همهٔ مردم شگفت‌زده شدند. از یکدیگر می‌پرسیدند: «چه اتفاقی می‌افتد؟

ar.L: فتحيّروا كلّهم، حتّى أخذوا يتساءلون فيما بينهم قائلين: «ما هذا؟
ar.B: فاستولت الدهشة عليهم جميعًا، وأخذوا يتناقشون فيما بينهم: «ما هذا؟
ar.R: فتعجّب كلّ الناس، وسأل بعضهم بعضًا: «ماذا يحدث؟

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਹੈਰਾਨ ਹੋਏ, ਇੱਥੋਂ ਤੱਕ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਆਪਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੁੱਛਣ ਲੱਗੇ, "ਇਹ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
pa.B: ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਅਚੰਭਾ ਕਰਨ ਲੱਗੇ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪੋ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਕਰਨ ਲੱਗੇ: "ਇਹ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
pa.R: ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਹੱਕੇ-ਬੱਕੇ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ। ਉਹ ਇੱਕ ਦੂਜੇ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛਣ ਲੱਗੇ, "ਇਹ ਕੀ ਹੋ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ?

alignments.target_span: 恐れと驚きに打たれて

decisions.choice: amazed: astonished, close to alarm
decisions.reason: The word is stronger than the one in 1:22 and has a sense of awe and fear.

decisions.choice: questioned among themselves: discussed and argued
decisions.reason: They talk it over with each other, trying to understand what they saw.

decisions.choice: the people speak among themselves in 해라체
decisions.reason: Between equals in a crowd the plain style is the default (style guide, section 4).

source.text: διδαχὴ καινή· κατ’ ἐξουσίαν καὶ τοῖς πνεύμασι τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις ἐπιτάσσει, καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: A teaching new with authority; even the spirits the unclean he commands, and they obey him.

en.L: A new teaching with authority! Even the unclean spirits {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commands, and they obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: A new kind of teaching, backed by authority! At {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} command even the unclean spirits do as they are told."
en.R: This man teaches something new, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} teaches with authority! He even tells evil spirits what to do, and they obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!"

vi.L: Một sự dạy dỗ mới, với thẩm quyền! Ngay cả các linh ô uế ông ấy cũng ra lệnh, và chúng vâng lời ông ấy."
vi.B: Một sự dạy dỗ mới mẻ, đầy thẩm quyền! Ông ấy ra lệnh cho cả các linh ô uế, và chúng phải vâng lời ông ấy."
vi.R: Người này dạy điều mới, và dạy với thẩm quyền! Ông ấy còn ra lệnh cho các tà linh, và chúng vâng lời ông ấy!"

ko.L: 권위 있는 새 가르침이다! 그분이 더러운 영들에게까지 명령하시고, 그들이 그분께 복종한다."
ko.B: 권위가 있는 새로운 가르침이다! 이분은 더러운 영들에게까지 명령하시는데, 그 영들이 이분께 복종한다!"
ko.R: 이분은 새로운 것을 가르치시는데, 권위가 있다! 이분이 악한 영들에게 명령하시면, 그 영들이 이분의 말에 복종한다!"

es.L: ¡Una enseñanza nueva con autoridad! Incluso a los espíritus impuros manda, y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen».
es.B: ¡Una enseñanza nueva, y con autoridad! Da órdenes hasta a los espíritus impuros, y ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen».
es.R: Este hombre enseña algo nuevo, ¡y lo enseña con autoridad! Hasta les da órdenes a los espíritus malignos, y ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen».

fr.L: Un enseignement nouveau, avec autorité ! Même aux esprits impurs {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} commande, et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent. »
fr.B: Voilà un enseignement nouveau, donné avec autorité ! Il commande même aux esprits impurs, et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent ! »
fr.R: Cet homme enseigne quelque chose de nouveau, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseigne avec autorité ! Il donne même des ordres aux esprits mauvais, et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent ! »

sw.L: Fundisho jipya lenye mamlaka! Hata pepo wachafu anawaamuru, nao wanamtii."
sw.B: Ni mafundisho mapya ya aina yake, yenye mamlaka! Kwa amri {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} hata pepo wachafu wanatii."
sw.R: Mtu huyu anafundisha kitu kipya, tena kwa mamlaka! Hata pepo wabaya anawaambia la kufanya, nao wanamtii!"

pt.L: Um ensino novo com autoridade! Até aos espíritos impuros {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dá ordens, e eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} obedecem."
pt.B: Um novo tipo de ensino, com autoridade! Às ordens {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, até os espíritos impuros obedecem."
pt.R: Este homem ensina uma coisa nova, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ensina com autoridade! Ele dá ordens até aos espíritos maus, e eles obedecem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}!"

am.L: በሥልጣን ያለ አዲስ ትምህርት! ርኩሳን መናፍስትን እንኳ ያዝዛቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ይታዘዙለታል።»
am.B: በሥልጣን የተደገፈ አዲስ ዓይነት ትምህርት ነው! ርኩሳን መናፍስት እንኳ በትእዛዙ የተባሉትን ያደርጋሉ።»
am.R: ይህ ሰው አዲስ ነገር ያስተምራል፤ በሥልጣንም ያስተምራል! ክፉ መናፍስትን እንኳ ያዝዛቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ይታዘዙለታል!»

ru.L: Новое учение со властью! И нечистым духам {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} повелевает, и они повинуются {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.»
ru.B: Новое учение, и с какой властью! По {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} приказу даже нечистые духи слушаются.»
ru.R: Этот человек учит новому, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} учит с властью! Он приказывает даже нечистым духам, и они {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} слушаются!»

hi.L: अधिकार के साथ नया उपदेश! वह अशुद्ध आत्माओं को भी आज्ञा देता है, और वे उसकी आज्ञा मानती हैं।"
hi.B: अधिकार के साथ एक नई तरह का उपदेश! उसके कहने पर तो अशुद्ध आत्माएँ भी उसकी बात मानती हैं।"
hi.R: यह आदमी कुछ नया सिखाता है, और अधिकार के साथ सिखाता है! वह बुरी आत्माओं को भी हुक्म देता है, और वे उसकी बात मानती हैं!"

uk.L: Нове вчення з владою! Навіть нечистим духам {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наказує, і вони слухаються {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.»
uk.B: Нове вчення, і за ним стоїть влада! Навіть нечисті духи виконують {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} накази.»
uk.R: Цей чоловік навчає чогось нового, і навчає з владою! Він навіть наказує злим духам, і вони {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} слухаються!»

ja.L: 権威ある新しい教えだ。[この人は]汚れた霊たちにさえ命じ、そして[霊たちは]この人に従う。」
ja.B: 権威ある、まったく新しい教えだ。この人が命じると、汚れた霊たちでさえ言うことを聞く。」
ja.R: この人は新しいことを、権威をもって教えている。汚れた霊にまで命令して、霊たちはこの人の言うことを聞くのだ。」

id.L: Suatu ajaran baru dengan kuasa! Bahkan roh-roh najis {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} perintah, dan mereka taat kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}."
id.B: Suatu ajaran yang baru, disertai wewenang! Atas perintah-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} roh-roh najis pun menurut."
id.R: Orang ini mengajarkan sesuatu yang baru, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} mengajar dengan wewenang! Bahkan roh-roh jahat pun {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} perintah, dan mereka taat kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}!"

zh.L: [这是]一个带着权柄的新教导！{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}连对污灵也发命令，它们也听从{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。”
zh.B: 这是一种带着权柄的新教导！连污灵都听从{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的命令。”
zh.R: 这个人教导的是新的东西，而且{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}教导的时候带着权柄！{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}甚至命令邪灵，邪灵也听从{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}！”

fa.L: تعلیمی تازه با اقتدار! حتی به روح‌های پلید فرمان می‌دهد و از او اطاعت می‌کنند.»
fa.B: تعلیمی تازه و همراه با اقتدار! به فرمان او حتی روح‌های پلید هم اطاعت می‌کنند.»
fa.R: این مرد چیز تازه‌ای تعلیم می‌دهد، و با اقتدار تعلیم می‌دهد! او حتی به روح‌های شریر می‌گوید چه کنند، و آن‌ها از او اطاعت می‌کنند!»

ar.L: تعليم جديد بسلطان! حتّى الأرواح النجسة يأمرها فتطيعه».
ar.B: هذا نوع جديد من التعليم، وفيه سلطان! حتّى الأرواح النجسة تفعل ما يأمرها به».
ar.R: هذا الرجل يعلّم شيئًا جديدًا، ويعلّم بسلطان! حتّى الأرواح الشرّيرة يقول لها ما تفعل، فتطيعه!».

pa.L: ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਇੱਕ ਨਵੀਂ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ! ਉਹ ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ ਆਤਮਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਹੁਕਮ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਕਹਿਣਾ ਮੰਨਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।"
pa.B: ਇਹ ਤਾਂ ਨਵੀਂ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਹੈ, ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ! ਉਸ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮ ਉੱਤੇ ਅਸ਼ੁੱਧ ਆਤਮਾਵਾਂ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਕਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਜੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਹਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।"
pa.R: ਇਹ ਬੰਦਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਵੀਂ ਗੱਲ ਸਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਸਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ! ਉਹ ਬੁਰੀਆਂ ਆਤਮਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਮੰਨਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ!"

decisions.choice: with authority goes with the new teaching
alternatives: with authority he commands even the unclean spirits
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT puts a break after "with authority", so the phrase describes the teaching. With the break before it, it describes the commands. Either way Jesus' word has authority.

decisions.choice: new: new in kind, not only recent
decisions.reason: The word means fresh or of a new kind. Teaching that drives out spirits by a word is something the people have not met before.

decisions.choice: even unclean spirits obey him: his word has God's power
decisions.reason: Jesus uses no ritual or name, only a command, and the spirits must obey.

decisions.choice: the crowd speaks of Jesus as "ông ấy", with no setting span
decisions.reason: The people do not yet know who he is; they speak of him as of a respected man, as the people in John 9:11-12 do. The narrator's "Ngài" stays for the narrator.

decisions.choice: the astonished people speak of Jesus with the honorific ("그분", "이분", "명령하시고")
decisions.reason: They are struck with awe at his authority, and a Korean speaker in awe refers to the person respectfully; the scribes in 2:6-7 and 2:16, who disapprove, speak of him without the honorific.

decisions.choice: plain "वह", "उसकी" for Jesus in the crowd's mouth
decisions.reason: The narrator uses the honorific for Jesus, but the crowd, talking among themselves about a stranger, speak of him plainly, as in Matthew.

decisions.choice: "この人" for Jesus in the crowd's words
decisions.reason: The crowd speaks among themselves in the plain style and does not yet know who Jesus is; "この人" is how Japanese speakers would refer to him, where English says "he".

decisions.choice: Plain "او" and the third person for Jesus in the crowd's mouth
decisions.reason: The people speak about him among themselves; Persian needs no form of respect here.

decisions.choice: "بسلطان" with the new teaching
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT puts the break after "with authority", so the phrase goes with the teaching (m1).

decisions.choice: Plain "ਉਹ", "ਉਸ ਦਾ" for Jesus in the crowd's mouth
decisions.reason: Style §5.

source.text: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εὐθὺς πανταχοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν περίχωρον τῆς Γαλιλαίας.

records.literal_gloss: And went out the report of him immediately everywhere into all the surrounding region of the Galilee.

en.L: And the report about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} went out immediately everywhere, into the whole surrounding region of Galilee.
en.B: The news about {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} went out at once in every direction, through all the country around Galilee.
en.R: Very quickly, people all over the area of Galilee heard about Jesus.

vi.L: Và tin tức về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lập tức lan ra khắp nơi, vào cả vùng chung quanh Ga-li-lê.
vi.B: Tin tức về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} liền lan ra khắp mọi nơi trong cả vùng quanh Ga-li-lê.
vi.R: Rất nhanh chóng, người ta khắp miền Ga-li-lê đều nghe nói về Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그리고 그분에 대한 소문이 곧 사방으로, 갈릴리 일대의 온 지역으로 퍼져 나갔다.
ko.B: 예수에 대한 소식이 곧바로 갈릴리 일대 곳곳으로 퍼져 나갔다.
ko.R: 곧 갈릴리 온 지역 사람들이 예수에 대해 듣게 되었다.

es.L: Y salió enseguida la noticia acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} por todas partes, a toda la región de alrededor de Galilea.
es.B: Muy pronto la noticia acerca de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se extendió por todas partes, por toda la comarca de Galilea.
es.R: Muy pronto, la gente de toda la región de Galilea oyó hablar de Jesús.

fr.L: Et la nouvelle à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sujet se répandit aussitôt partout, dans toute la région environnante de la Galilée.
fr.B: On parla de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussitôt dans toutes les directions, à travers toute la région de Galilée.
fr.R: Très vite, dans toute la région de Galilée, les gens ont entendu parler de Jésus.

sw.L: Na habari {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zikaenea mara moja kila mahali katika eneo lote linalozunguka Galilaya.
sw.B: Habari {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zikaenea upesi pande zote, katika nchi yote inayozunguka Galilaya.
sw.R: Upesi sana watu kila mahali katika eneo la Galilaya walisikia habari za Yesu.

pt.L: E a notícia a respeito {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} saiu imediatamente por toda parte, para toda a região ao redor da Galileia.
pt.B: A notícia sobre {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} logo se espalhou em todas as direções, por toda a região em volta da Galileia.
pt.R: Bem depressa, as pessoas de toda a região da Galileia ouviram falar de Jesus.

am.L: ስለ እርሱም የተነገረው ወሬ ወዲያውኑ በየስፍራው በዙሪያው ወዳለው ወደ ገሊላ አገር ሁሉ ወጣ።
am.B: ስለ እርሱ የተሰማው ወሬ ወዲያው በየአቅጣጫው በገሊላ ዙሪያ ባለው አገር ሁሉ ተዳረሰ።
am.R: ብዙም ሳይቆይ በገሊላ አካባቢ ያሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ስለ ኢየሱስ ሰሙ።

ru.L: И вышел слух о {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} тотчас повсюду, во всю окрестность Галилеи.
ru.B: Весть о {{deity_pronoun:нём|Нём}} сразу разнеслась повсюду, по всей округе Галилеи.
ru.R: Очень скоро люди по всей Галилее услышали об Иисусе.

hi.L: और उनकी चर्चा तुरंत गलील के आस-पास के सारे प्रदेश में हर जगह फैल गई।
hi.B: उनकी चर्चा उसी समय गलील के आस-पास के सारे इलाक़े में चारों ओर फैल गई।
hi.R: बहुत जल्दी गलील के सारे इलाक़े में लोगों ने यीशु के बारे में सुन लिया।

uk.L: І вийшла чутка про {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} зараз же скрізь, по всій околиці Галилеї.
uk.B: Звістка про {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} швидко розійшлася всюди, по всьому краю довкола Галилеї.
uk.R: Дуже швидко про Ісуса почули люди по всій Галилеї.

ja.L: そしてイエスのうわさは、すぐに、ガリラヤの周辺の全地方の至る所に広まって行った。
ja.B: イエスの評判は、たちまちガリラヤ周辺の地方一帯に広まった。
ja.R: イエスのことは、あっという間にガリラヤ地方のあちこちに知れ渡りました。

id.L: Dan kabar tentang {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} segera tersebar ke mana-mana, ke seluruh daerah sekitar Galilea.
id.B: Kabar tentang {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} segera tersebar ke segala penjuru, ke seluruh daerah di sekitar Galilea.
id.R: Dengan cepat orang-orang di seluruh daerah Galilea mendengar tentang Yesus.

zh.L: 关于{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的传闻立即传遍各处，到了加利利周围整个地区。
zh.B: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}的消息很快就向四面八方传开，传遍了加利利周围的一切地方。
zh.R: 很快，加利利各地的人都听说了耶稣的事。

fa.L: و آوازهٔ او فوراً به همه‌جا، در سراسر نواحی اطراف جلیل، پیچید.
fa.B: خبر او بی‌درنگ به هر سو، در سراسر نواحی اطراف جلیل، پخش شد.
fa.R: خیلی زود مردم در سراسر ناحیهٔ جلیل دربارهٔ عیسی شنیدند.

ar.L: فخرج خبره للوقت إلى كلّ مكان، في كلّ المنطقة المحيطة بالجليل.
ar.B: وانتشر الخبر عنه في الحال في كلّ اتّجاه، في كلّ النواحي المحيطة بالجليل.
ar.R: وبسرعة كبيرة سمع الناس عن يسوع في كلّ أنحاء منطقة الجليل.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਚਰਚਾ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਹਰ ਪਾਸੇ, ਗਲੀਲ ਦੇ ਆਲੇ-ਦੁਆਲੇ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਇਲਾਕੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਫੈਲ ਗਈ।
pa.B: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਛੇਤੀ ਹੀ ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਸੇ, ਗਲੀਲ ਦੇ ਲਾਗਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਦੇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਗਈ।
pa.R: ਬਹੁਤ ਛੇਤੀ ਗਲੀਲ ਦੇ ਇਲਾਕੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਦੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੇ ਯਿਸੂ ਬਾਰੇ ਸੁਣ ਲਿਆ।

decisions.choice: the surrounding region of Galilee: the whole region of Galilee round about
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely means all of Galilee around Capernaum, though it could include lands beyond it.

decisions.choice: report: what people heard and told about him
decisions.reason: The word means something heard, news passed on by word of mouth.

decisions.choice: "갈릴리 일대" (L, B); "갈릴리 온 지역" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as the whole region of Galilee round about; "갈릴리 주변" would suggest the lands around Galilee, outside it.

source.text: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐξελθόντες ἦλθον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος καὶ Ἀνδρέου μετὰ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately out of the synagogue having gone out they came into the house of Simon and Andrew with James and John.

en.L: And immediately, going out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
en.B: They left the synagogue and went straight to the house where Simon and Andrew lived, and James and John came with them.
en.R: Right after that, they left the synagogue and went to Simon and Andrew's house. James and John went with them.

vi.L: Và lập tức, ra khỏi nhà hội, họ đến nhà của Si-môn và Anh-rê, cùng với Gia-cơ và Giăng.
vi.B: Vừa ra khỏi nhà hội, họ đi thẳng đến nhà của Si-môn và Anh-rê, có Gia-cơ và Giăng cùng đi.
vi.R: Ngay sau đó, họ rời nhà hội và đi đến nhà của Si-môn và Anh-rê. Gia-cơ và Giăng cũng đi với họ.

ko.L: 그리고 곧 그들은 회당에서 나와서, 야고보와 요한과 함께 시몬과 안드레의 집으로 들어갔다.
ko.B: 그들은 회당에서 나오자 곧바로 시몬과 안드레가 사는 집으로 갔다. 야고보와 요한도 함께 갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 회당에서 나와 바로 시몬과 안드레의 집으로 갔다. 야고보와 요한도 함께 갔다.

es.L: Y enseguida, saliendo de la sinagoga, fueron a la casa de Simón y Andrés, con Santiago y Juan.
es.B: En cuanto salieron de la sinagoga, fueron a la casa de Simón y Andrés, y Santiago y Juan fueron con ellos.
es.R: Enseguida salieron de la sinagoga y fueron a la casa de Simón y Andrés. Santiago y Juan fueron con ellos.

fr.L: Et aussitôt, étant sortis de la synagogue, ils vinrent dans la maison de Simon et d’André, avec Jacques et Jean.
fr.B: En sortant de la synagogue, ils allèrent tout droit à la maison de Simon et d’André, avec Jacques et Jean.
fr.R: Juste après, ils sont sortis de la synagogue et ils sont allés chez Simon et André. Jacques et Jean étaient avec eux.

sw.L: Na mara moja, wakitoka katika sinagogi, wakaingia nyumbani mwa Simoni na Andrea, pamoja na Yakobo na Yohana.
sw.B: Walitoka sinagogini, wakaenda moja kwa moja nyumbani kwa Simoni na Andrea, na Yakobo na Yohana walikwenda pamoja nao.
sw.R: Mara baada ya hapo, walitoka katika sinagogi, wakaenda nyumbani kwa Simoni na Andrea. Yakobo na Yohana walikwenda pamoja nao.

pt.L: E imediatamente, saindo da sinagoga, foram para a casa de Simão e André, com Tiago e João.
pt.B: Eles saíram da sinagoga e foram direto para a casa onde Simão e André moravam; Tiago e João foram com eles.
pt.R: Logo depois, eles saíram da sinagoga e foram para a casa de Simão e André. Tiago e João foram com eles.

am.L: ወዲያውኑም ከምኩራብ ወጥተው ከያዕቆብና ከዮሐንስ ጋር ወደ ስምዖንና ወደ እንድርያስ ቤት መጡ።
am.B: ከምኩራብ ወጥተው በቀጥታ ስምዖንና እንድርያስ ወደሚኖሩበት ቤት ሄዱ፤ ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስም አብረዋቸው ነበሩ።
am.R: ወዲያው ከምኩራብ ወጥተው ወደ ስምዖንና ወደ እንድርያስ ቤት ሄዱ። ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስም ከእነርሱ ጋር ሄዱ።

ru.L: И тотчас, выйдя из синагоги, они пришли в дом Симона и Андрея с Иаковом и Иоанном.
ru.B: Из синагоги они сразу пошли в дом, где жили Симон и Андрей, и с ними пошли Иаков и Иоанн.
ru.R: Сразу после этого они вышли из синагоги и пошли в дом Симона и Андрея. Иаков и Иоанн пошли с ними.

hi.L: और तुरंत आराधनालय से निकलकर वे याकूब और यूहन्ना के साथ शमौन और अन्द्रियास के घर आए।
hi.B: आराधनालय से निकलकर वे सीधे उस घर में गए जहाँ शमौन और अन्द्रियास रहते थे, और याकूब और यूहन्ना भी उनके साथ थे।
hi.R: इसके तुरंत बाद वे आराधनालय से निकलकर शमौन और अन्द्रियास के घर गए। याकूब और यूहन्ना भी उनके साथ गए।

uk.L: І зараз же, вийшовши із синагоги, вони прийшли в дім Симона й Андрія з Яковом та Іваном.
uk.B: Вийшовши із синагоги, вони одразу пішли до дому, де жили Симон і Андрій; Яків та Іван були з ними.
uk.R: Одразу після цього вони вийшли із синагоги й пішли додому до Симона та Андрія. Яків та Іван пішли з ними.

ja.L: そしてすぐに、会堂から出て、彼らはヤコブとヨハネと共に、シモンとアンデレの家に来た。
ja.B: 一行は会堂を出ると、まっすぐシモンとアンデレの家に行った。ヤコブとヨハネも一緒であった。
ja.R: そのすぐ後、イエスと弟子たちは会堂を出て、シモンとアンデレの家に行きました。ヤコブとヨハネも一緒に行きました。

id.L: Dan segera, setelah keluar dari rumah ibadat, mereka masuk ke rumah Simon dan Andreas, bersama Yakobus dan Yohanes.
id.B: Mereka meninggalkan sinagoge itu dan langsung pergi ke rumah Simon dan Andreas, dan Yakobus serta Yohanes ikut bersama mereka.
id.R: Sesudah itu mereka meninggalkan rumah ibadat itu dan pergi ke rumah Simon dan Andreas. Yakobus dan Yohanes ikut bersama mereka.

zh.L: 他们一出会堂，立即同雅各、约翰来到西门和安得烈的家。
zh.B: 他们离开会堂，直接到了西门和安得烈住的家，雅各和约翰也跟他们一起去。
zh.R: 他们离开会堂以后，马上去了西门和安得烈的家。雅各和约翰也跟他们一起去了。

fa.L: و فوراً از کنیسه بیرون آمدند و با یعقوب و یوحنا به خانهٔ شمعون و آندریاس رفتند.
fa.B: آنان کنیسه را ترک کردند و یک‌راست به خانه‌ای رفتند که شمعون و آندریاس در آن زندگی می‌کردند، و یعقوب و یوحنا نیز همراهشان آمدند.
fa.R: درست پس از آن، از کنیسه بیرون آمدند و به خانهٔ شمعون و آندریاس رفتند. یعقوب و یوحنا هم با آنان رفتند.

ar.L: وللوقت لمّا خرجوا من المجمع، جاؤوا إلى بيت سمعان وأندراوس، ومعهم يعقوب ويوحنا.
ar.B: ثمّ خرجوا من المجمع وذهبوا مباشرة إلى البيت الذي كان يسكنه سمعان وأندراوس، وكان معهم يعقوب ويوحنا.
ar.R: وبعد ذلك مباشرة خرجوا من المجمع، وذهبوا إلى بيت سمعان وأندراوس. وذهب معهم يعقوب ويوحنا.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਸਭਾ-ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਯਾਕੂਬ ਅਤੇ ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਦਰਿਯਾਸ ਦੇ ਘਰ ਆਏ।
pa.B: ਪ੍ਰਾਰਥਨਾ ਘਰ ਤੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਸਿੱਧੇ ਉਸ ਘਰ ਗਏ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਦਰਿਯਾਸ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਸਨ, ਅਤੇ ਯਾਕੂਬ ਅਤੇ ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਵੀ ਨਾਲ ਆਏ।
pa.R: ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਛੇਤੀ ਬਾਅਦ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਾਰਥਨਾ ਘਰ ਤੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲੇ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਦਰਿਯਾਸ ਦੇ ਘਰ ਗਏ। ਯਾਕੂਬ ਅਤੇ ਯੂਹੰਨਾ ਵੀ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਗਏ।

decisions.choice: they went out and came: the plural, the reading of the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts have the singular, with Jesus as the subject. With the plural, "they" are Jesus and the four disciples. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: the house of Simon and Andrew: the brothers' home in Capernaum
alternatives: a house they rented for Jesus
decisions.reason: John 1:44 says the brothers came from Bethsaida; by now they lived in Capernaum, where Simon's family was.

source.text: ἡ δὲ πενθερὰ Σίμωνος κατέκειτο πυρέσσουσα, καὶ εὐθὺς λέγουσιν αὐτῷ περὶ αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: And the mother-in-law of Simon was lying down fevering, and immediately they speak to him about her.

en.L: Now Simon's mother-in-law was lying down sick with a fever, and immediately they tell {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about her.
en.B: Simon's mother-in-law lay ill with a fever, and they lost no time in telling {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} about her.
en.R: Simon's mother-in-law was lying in bed with a fever. Right away they told Jesus that she was sick.

vi.L: Và mẹ vợ của Si-môn đang nằm, bị sốt, và lập tức họ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về bà.
vi.B: Mẹ vợ của Si-môn đang nằm vì bị sốt, nên họ liền thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} về bà.
vi.R: Mẹ vợ của Si-môn đang bị sốt, nằm trên giường. Họ liền cho Đức Giê-xu biết bà bị bệnh.

ko.L: 그런데 시몬의 장모가 열병으로 누워 있었다. 그리고 곧 그들이 그분께 그 여자에 관하여 말씀드린다.
ko.B: 시몬의 장모가 열병으로 앓아누워 있었는데, 사람들은 지체 없이 예수께 그 사실을 알려 드렸다.
ko.R: 시몬의 장모는 열이 나서 자리에 누워 있었다. 그들은 바로 예수께 장모가 아프다고 말씀드렸다.

es.L: Y la suegra de Simón estaba acostada con fiebre, y enseguida {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hablan de ella.
es.B: La suegra de Simón estaba en cama con fiebre, y enseguida {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} hablaron de ella.
es.R: La suegra de Simón estaba acostada con fiebre. Enseguida avisaron a Jesús de que estaba enferma.

fr.L: Or la belle-mère de Simon était couchée, ayant de la fièvre, et aussitôt ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} parlent d’elle.
fr.B: La belle-mère de Simon était au lit avec de la fièvre, et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} parlèrent d’elle sans tarder.
fr.R: La belle-mère de Simon était au lit, elle avait de la fièvre. Tout de suite, ils ont dit à Jésus qu’elle était malade.

sw.L: Basi mama mkwe wa Simoni alikuwa amelala akiwa na homa, na mara moja wanamwambia habari zake.
sw.B: Mama mkwe wa Simoni alikuwa amelala kitandani akiugua homa, nao bila kukawia wakamweleza Yesu habari zake.
sw.R: Mama mkwe wa Simoni alikuwa amelala kitandani, ana homa. Mara moja wakamwambia Yesu kwamba alikuwa mgonjwa.

pt.L: E a sogra de Simão estava deitada com febre, e imediatamente {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} falam a respeito dela.
pt.B: A sogra de Simão estava de cama, com febre, e sem demora {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} falaram dela.
pt.R: A sogra de Simão estava de cama, com febre. Logo contaram a Jesus que ela estava doente.

am.L: የስምዖን አማት ግን ትኩሳት ይዟት ተኝታ ነበር፤ ወዲያውኑም ስለ እርሷ ይነግሩታል።
am.B: የስምዖን አማት ትኩሳት ይዟት ተኝታ ነበር፤ እነርሱም ሳይዘገዩ ስለ እርሷ ነገሩት።
am.R: የስምዖን አማት ትኩሳት ይዟት በአልጋ ላይ ተኝታ ነበር። ወዲያው መታመሟን ለኢየሱስ ነገሩት።

ru.L: Тёща же Симона лежала в жару, и тотчас говорят {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} о ней.
ru.B: Тёща Симона лежала больная, в жару, и {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} не медля сказали о ней.
ru.R: Тёща Симона лежала в постели с высокой температурой. Они сразу сказали Иисусу, что она больна.

hi.L: और शमौन की सास बुख़ार में पड़ी थी, और तुरंत [लोग] उसके विषय में उनसे कहते हैं।
hi.B: शमौन की सास बुख़ार से बीमार पड़ी थी, और उन्होंने बिना देर किए यीशु को उसके बारे में बताया।
hi.R: शमौन की सास बुख़ार से बिस्तर पर पड़ी थी। उन्होंने तुरंत यीशु को बताया कि वह बीमार है।

uk.L: А теща Симона лежала в гарячці, і зараз же кажуть {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} про неї.
uk.B: Симонова теща лежала хвора з гарячкою, і {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} відразу розповіли про неї.
uk.R: Симонова теща лежала в ліжку з гарячкою. Ісусові одразу сказали, що вона хвора.

ja.L: さて、シモンのしゅうとめが熱を出して寝ていた。そしてすぐに、人々は彼女のことをイエスに話す。
ja.B: シモンのしゅうとめは熱を出して床に就いていたので、人々はさっそく彼女のことをイエスに話した。
ja.R: シモンの妻のお母さんが、熱を出して寝ていました。人々はすぐに、そのことをイエスに話しました。

id.L: Ibu mertua Simon terbaring karena sakit demam, dan segera mereka memberi tahu-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} tentang dia.
id.B: Ibu mertua Simon terbaring sakit demam, dan mereka segera memberi tahu Yesus tentang dia.
id.R: Ibu mertua Simon sedang berbaring di tempat tidur karena demam. Mereka langsung memberi tahu Yesus bahwa dia sakit.

zh.L: 西门的岳母正发烧躺着，他们就立即对{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}说起她。
zh.B: 西门的岳母发烧，卧病在床，他们赶紧把她的事告诉{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。
zh.R: 西门的岳母发烧，躺在床上。他们马上告诉耶稣她病了。

fa.L: و مادرزن شمعون تب‌دار خوابیده بود، و فوراً دربارهٔ او به او می‌گویند.
fa.B: مادرزن شمعون از تب بستری بود، و بی‌درنگ دربارهٔ او به عیسی گفتند.
fa.R: مادرزن شمعون تب داشت و در بستر بود. آنان بی‌درنگ به عیسی گفتند که او بیمار است.

ar.L: وكانت حماة سمعان مضطجعة محمومة، وللوقت يكلّمونه عنها.
ar.B: وكانت حماة سمعان طريحة الفراش من الحمّى، فلم يتأخّروا في إخباره عنها.
ar.R: وكانت حماة سمعان في الفراش، وعندها حمّى. فأخبروا يسوع فورًا أنّها مريضة.

pa.L: ਹੁਣ ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਦੀ ਸੱਸ ਤਾਪ ਨਾਲ ਬਿਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਹੋਈ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਉਹ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਬਾਰੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਦੱਸਦੇ ਹਨ।
pa.B: ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਦੀ ਸੱਸ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਮੰਜੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਪਈ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਦੇਰ ਕੀਤੇ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਬਾਰੇ ਦੱਸਿਆ।
pa.R: ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਦੀ ਸੱਸ ਨੂੰ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਰ ਸੀ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਮੰਜੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਲੇਟੀ ਹੋਈ ਸੀ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਝੱਟ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਬਿਮਾਰ ਹੈ।

decisions.choice: Simon's mother-in-law: Simon was married
decisions.reason: Paul says that Peter took his wife with him on his travels (1 Corinthians 9:5).

decisions.choice: lying down with a fever: too ill to get up
decisions.reason: Fever could be a sign of serious illness, and she was in bed with it.

decisions.choice: they speak: the present tense of storytelling
decisions.reason: Mark tells this in the present tense to make it vivid.

decisions.choice: "장모"; "말씀드리다", "알려 드리다" for telling Jesus
decisions.reason: Korean names a man's mother-in-law "장모" (his wife's mother); "시어머니" is a woman's mother-in-law. Speaking to Jesus is expressed with the humble verbs "말씀드리다" and "-어 드리다" in the narrative, as the honorific requires.

decisions.choice: present "話す" (L); past "話した" (B), "話しました" (R)
decisions.reason: Mark tells past events in the present tense (m3). Literal keeps the present; Balanced and Readable narrate in the past, as Japanese storytelling does. This holds for the historic presents through this passage (1:29-39).

decisions.choice: "حماة سمعان"
decisions.reason: The mother of Simon's wife (m1): Arabic "حماة" is exactly that.

source.text: καὶ προσελθὼν ἤγειρεν αὐτὴν κρατήσας τῆς χειρός· καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός, καὶ διηκόνει αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And having come to [her] he raised her having taken hold of the hand; and left her the fever, and she was serving them.

en.L: And coming to [her], {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised her up, taking hold of [her] hand; and the fever left her, and she began serving them.
en.B: He came over, took hold of her hand, and lifted her up. Her fever was gone, and she started to look after them.
en.R: Jesus went to her. He took her hand and helped her get up. The fever went away, and she began to serve them food.

vi.L: Và đến gần, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đỡ bà dậy, nắm lấy tay [bà]; và cơn sốt rời khỏi bà, và bà phục vụ họ.
vi.B: Ngài đến bên bà, nắm tay bà và đỡ bà dậy. Cơn sốt dứt, và bà bắt đầu tiếp đãi họ.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đến bên bà. Ngài nắm tay bà và giúp bà ngồi dậy. Cơn sốt dứt hẳn, và bà bắt đầu dọn thức ăn cho họ.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 다가가셔서 손을 잡고 그 여자를 일으키셨다. 그러자 열이 그 여자에게서 떠났고, 그 여자는 그들을 섬기기 시작했다.
ko.B: 예수께서 다가가셔서 그 여자의 손을 잡아 일으키셨다. 그러자 열이 내렸고, 그 여자는 그들을 대접하기 시작했다.
ko.R: 예수께서 장모에게 가셨다. 예수께서 그 손을 잡고 일으켜 주셨다. 그러자 열이 내렸다. 장모는 그들에게 음식을 차려 주었다.

es.L: Y acercándose, la levantó tomándola de la mano; y la fiebre la dejó, y ella les servía.
es.B: Él se acercó, la tomó de la mano y la levantó. Se le quitó la fiebre, y se puso a atenderlos.
es.R: Jesús se acercó a ella. La tomó de la mano y la ayudó a levantarse. La fiebre se le fue, y ella comenzó a servirles comida.

fr.L: Et s’étant approché, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la releva, l’ayant prise par la main ; et la fièvre la quitta, et elle les servait.
fr.B: Il s’approcha, la prit par la main et la fit se lever. La fièvre la quitta, et elle se mit à les servir.
fr.R: Jésus s’est approché d’elle. Il lui a pris la main et l’a aidée à se lever. La fièvre est partie, et elle s’est mise à leur servir à manger.

sw.L: Naye akimkaribia, akamwinua, akimshika mkono; na homa ikamwacha, naye akaanza kuwahudumia.
sw.B: Akamwendea, akamshika mkono, akamwinua. Homa ikamwacha, naye akaanza kuwahudumia.
sw.R: Yesu alimwendea, akamshika mkono, akamsaidia kuinuka. Homa ikaisha, naye akaanza kuwaandalia chakula.

pt.L: E, aproximando-se, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a levantou, segurando [a] mão [dela]; e a febre a deixou, e ela começou a servi-los.
pt.B: Ele se aproximou, segurou a mão dela e a levantou. A febre a deixou, e ela começou a cuidar deles.
pt.R: Jesus foi até ela. Ele pegou a mão dela e a ajudou a se levantar. A febre foi embora, e ela começou a servir uma refeição para eles.

am.L: ቀርቦም እጇን ይዞ አስነሣት፤ ትኩሳቱም ለቀቃት፤ እርሷም ታገለግላቸው ጀመር።
am.B: ወደ እርሷ ቀርቦ እጇን ያዘና አስነሣት። ትኩሳቱም ለቀቃት፤ እርሷም ታስተናግዳቸው ጀመር።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ወደ እርሷ ሄደ። እጇን ይዞ እንድትነሣ ረዳት። ትኩሳቱም ጠፋ፤ እርሷም ምግብ ታቀርብላቸው ጀመር።

ru.L: И, подойдя, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поднял её, взяв за руку; и оставил её жар, и она служила им.
ru.B: Он подошёл, взял её за руку и поднял. Жар оставил её, и она стала заботиться о них.
ru.R: Иисус подошёл к ней. Он взял её за руку и помог ей встать. Жар прошёл, и она начала готовить им еду.

hi.L: और उन्होंने पास जाकर उसका हाथ पकड़कर उसे उठाया; और बुख़ार ने उसे छोड़ दिया, और वह उनकी सेवा करने लगी।
hi.B: उन्होंने पास जाकर उसका हाथ पकड़ा और उसे उठाया। उसका बुख़ार उतर गया, और वह उनकी आवभगत करने लगी।
hi.R: यीशु उसके पास गए। उन्होंने उसका हाथ पकड़कर उसे उठने में मदद की। बुख़ार चला गया, और वह उन्हें खाना परोसने लगी।

uk.L: І, підійшовши, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} підняв її, узявши за руку; і гарячка покинула її, і вона служила їм.
uk.B: Він підійшов, узяв її за руку й підняв. Гарячка минула, і вона почала їм прислуговувати.
uk.R: Ісус підійшов до неї. Він узяв її за руку й допоміг устати. Гарячка минула, і вона почала подавати їм їжу.

ja.L: そしてイエスは近寄って、その手を取って彼女を起こされた。すると熱が彼女から去り、彼女は彼らに仕え始めた。
ja.B: イエスがそばに行き、その手を取って起こされると、熱は去り、彼女は一同をもてなし始めた。
ja.R: イエスはそのそばに行き、手を取って起こされました。すると、熱が下がりました。そして、その人はみんなに食事を出して、もてなし始めました。

id.L: Dan setelah datang [kepadanya], {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} membangunkannya dengan memegang tangan[nya]; dan demam itu meninggalkan dia, dan dia mulai melayani mereka.
id.B: Dia mendekat, memegang tangannya, lalu membangunkannya. Demamnya hilang, dan dia mulai melayani mereka.
id.R: Yesus datang kepadanya. Dia memegang tangan perempuan itu dan menolongnya bangun. Demamnya hilang, dan dia mulai menyajikan makanan bagi mereka.

zh.L: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}进前来，拉住[她的]手，扶她起来；热病就离开了她，她便开始服侍他们。
zh.B: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}走过去，拉住她的手，扶她起来。她的烧退了，就开始招待他们。
zh.R: 耶稣走到她身边，拉着她的手，扶她起来。她的烧退了，她就开始给他们准备饭菜。

fa.L: و نزد [او] آمد، دستش را گرفت و برخیزانیدش؛ و تب او را رها کرد و به خدمت ایشان مشغول شد.
fa.B: عیسی نزد او رفت، دستش را گرفت و برخیزانیدش. تبش قطع شد و به پذیرایی از ایشان پرداخت.
fa.R: عیسی نزد او رفت. دستش را گرفت و کمکش کرد تا برخیزد. تب از او رفت و او شروع کرد به آوردن غذا برای ایشان.

ar.L: فتقدّم وأقامها ممسكًا بيدها، فتركتها الحمّى، وأخذت تخدمهم.
ar.B: فاقترب منها، وأمسك بيدها، وأنهضها. فزالت عنها الحمّى، وقامت تهتمّ بهم.
ar.R: فذهب يسوع إليها، وأمسك يدها وساعدها على النهوض. فذهبت عنها الحمّى، وبدأت تقدّم لهم الطعام.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਕੋਲ ਆ ਕੇ, [ਉਸ ਦਾ] ਹੱਥ ਫੜ ਕੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਉਠਾਇਆ; ਅਤੇ ਤਾਪ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਗਿਆ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਨ ਲੱਗ ਪਈ।
pa.B: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਕੋਲ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਹੱਥ ਫੜਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਉਠਾ ਕੇ ਖੜ੍ਹਾ ਕੀਤਾ। ਉਸ ਦਾ ਬੁਖ਼ਾਰ ਲਹਿ ਗਿਆ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਆਓ-ਭਗਤ ਕਰਨ ਲੱਗੀ।
pa.R: ਯਿਸੂ ਉਸ ਕੋਲ ਗਏ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਹੱਥ ਫੜ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਉੱਠਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕੀਤੀ। ਬੁਖ਼ਾਰ ਉੱਤਰ ਗਿਆ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਖਾਣਾ ਖੁਆਉਣ ਲੱਗੀ।

decisions.choice: raised her up: helped her to stand
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for raising the dead (5:41; 16:6), but here it means getting her up from her bed.

decisions.choice: serving them: looking after them as her guests
decisions.reason: She took up the work of a host, which shows that the cure was complete. The same verb is used of the angels in 1:13 and of Jesus himself in 10:45.

decisions.choice: she began serving: the imperfect describes what she went on doing
decisions.reason: The verb is continuous: she got up and set about caring for them.

decisions.choice: serve them food
decisions.reason: Readable says what serving guests most likely meant here: giving them a meal.

decisions.choice: "섬기다" (L); "대접하다" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal uses "섬기다", the same word as for the angels in 1:13, as the Greek repeats its verb; Balanced uses "대접하다" (look after guests), the sense here (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "仕え始めた" (L); "もてなし始めた" (B); "食事を出して、もてなし始めました" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb used of the angels in 1:13 ("仕えていた"), so the link the meaning decision notes (m2) can be seen. Balanced and Readable say what serving guests meant in a home, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "تخدمهم" (L), "تهتمّ بهم" (B), "تقدّم لهم الطعام" (R)
decisions.reason: She takes up the work of a host (m2). Literal keeps "خدم", the verb used of the angels in 1:13 and of Jesus in 10:45.

source.text: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης, ὅτε ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος, ἔφερον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας καὶ τοὺς δαιμονιζομένους·

records.literal_gloss: Evening and having come, when set the sun, they were bringing to him all the [ones] badly having and the [ones] being demon-possessed.

en.L: Now when evening had come, when the sun set, they were bringing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all who were sick and those who were demon-possessed.
en.B: When evening came and the sun had set, people began bringing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} everyone who was ill or controlled by demons.
en.R: That evening, after the sun went down, people brought all the sick to Jesus, and all who had demons in them.

vi.L: Khi chiều đến, lúc mặt trời đã lặn, người ta đem đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tất cả những người đau ốm và những người bị quỷ ám.
vi.B: Chiều hôm ấy, khi mặt trời đã lặn, người ta bắt đầu đem đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mọi người đau ốm và những người bị quỷ ám.
vi.R: Chiều hôm đó, sau khi mặt trời lặn, người ta đem tất cả những người bệnh và những người bị quỷ nhập đến với Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 저녁이 되어 해가 졌을 때, 사람들이 모든 앓는 사람들과 귀신 들린 사람들을 그분께로 데려오고 있었다.
ko.B: 저녁이 되어 해가 지자, 사람들이 아픈 사람들과 귀신 들린 사람들을 모두 예수께 데려오기 시작했다.
ko.R: 그날 저녁 해가 진 뒤에, 사람들이 아픈 사람들을 모두 예수께 데려왔다. 귀신 들린 사람들도 데려왔다.

es.L: Y llegada la tarde, cuando se puso el sol, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} traían a todos los que estaban enfermos y a los endemoniados.
es.B: Al anochecer, cuando ya se había puesto el sol, la gente {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} llevaba a todos los enfermos y a los que estaban dominados por demonios.
es.R: Esa tarde, después de que se puso el sol, la gente llevó a Jesús a todos los enfermos y a todos los que tenían demonios.

fr.L: Le soir venu, quand le soleil se fut couché, ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amenaient tous ceux qui étaient malades et ceux qui étaient possédés par des démons.
fr.B: Le soir, après le coucher du soleil, on se mit à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amener tous les malades et tous ceux qui étaient possédés par des démons.
fr.R: Ce soir-là, après le coucher du soleil, les gens ont amené à Jésus tous les malades, et tous ceux qui avaient des démons en eux.

sw.L: Na jioni ilipofika, jua lilipotua, walikuwa wakimletea wote waliokuwa wagonjwa na wale waliopagawa na pepo.
sw.B: Jioni ilipofika na jua likiwa limekwisha kutua, watu walianza kumletea wote waliokuwa wagonjwa au waliotawaliwa na pepo.
sw.R: Jioni ile, jua lilipokwisha kuzama, watu walimletea Yesu wagonjwa wote na wote waliokuwa na pepo.

pt.L: E, chegada a tarde, quando o sol se pôs, traziam-{{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} todos os que estavam doentes e os endemoninhados.
pt.B: Ao anoitecer, depois que o sol se pôs, começaram a trazer a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} todos os que estavam doentes ou endemoninhados.
pt.R: Naquela noite, depois que o sol se pôs, as pessoas trouxeram a Jesus todos os doentes e todos os que tinham demônios dentro deles.

am.L: በመሸም ጊዜ፣ ፀሐይ በገባች ጊዜ፣ የታመሙትን ሁሉና አጋንንት ያደረባቸውን ወደ እርሱ ያመጡ ነበር።
am.B: በመሸ ጊዜ ፀሐይ ከጠለቀች በኋላ ሰዎች የታመሙትንና በአጋንንት የተያዙትን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ያመጡ ጀመር።
am.R: በዚያ ምሽት ፀሐይ ከጠለቀች በኋላ ሰዎች የታመሙትን ሁሉ ወደ ኢየሱስ አመጡ፤ አጋንንት ያደረባቸውንም ሁሉ አመጡ።

ru.L: Когда же настал вечер, когда зашло солнце, приносили к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} всех больных и бесноватых.
ru.B: Когда настал вечер и солнце село, к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} стали приводить всех больных и одержимых бесами.
ru.R: В тот вечер, когда солнце зашло, люди привели к Иисусу всех больных и всех, в ком были бесы.

hi.L: और साँझ होने पर, जब सूरज डूब गया, [लोग] सब बीमारों और दुष्टात्मा-ग्रस्त लोगों को उनके पास लाने लगे।
hi.B: शाम को, जब सूरज डूब चुका था, लोग सब बीमारों को और उन्हें जिन पर दुष्टात्माओं का क़ब्ज़ा था, उनके पास लाने लगे।
hi.R: उस शाम, सूरज डूबने के बाद, लोग सब बीमारों को यीशु के पास ले आए, और उन सबको भी जिनमें दुष्टात्माएँ थीं।

uk.L: А коли настав вечір, коли зайшло сонце, приносили до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} всіх, що нездужали, і біснуватих.
uk.B: Коли настав вечір і сонце зайшло, люди почали приносити до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} всіх хворих і тих, ким володіли біси.
uk.R: Того вечора, після заходу сонця, люди привели до Ісуса всіх хворих і всіх, у кому були біси.

ja.L: さて、夕方になって、日が沈んだとき、人々は病気の者たちすべてと悪霊に取りつかれた者たちを、イエスのもとへ連れて来ていた。
ja.B: 夕方になって日が沈むと、人々は、病気の人や悪霊に取りつかれた人をみな、イエスのもとに連れて来始めた。
ja.R: その日の夕方、日が沈んでから、人々は病気の人たちをみな、イエスのところに連れて来ました。悪霊に取りつかれた人たちも連れて来ました。

id.L: Dan ketika hari sudah malam, ketika matahari terbenam, mereka membawa kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} semua orang yang sakit dan yang kerasukan setan.
id.B: Ketika hari menjelang malam dan matahari sudah terbenam, orang-orang mulai membawa kepada-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} semua yang sakit atau yang dikuasai roh jahat.
id.R: Malam itu, sesudah matahari terbenam, orang-orang membawa kepada Yesus semua orang sakit dan semua orang yang dirasuki roh jahat.

zh.L: 到了傍晚，日落的时候，人们陆续把所有患病的和被鬼附的都带到{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}那里。
zh.B: 傍晚日落以后，人们开始把所有生病的和受邪灵控制的人都带到{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}面前。
zh.R: 那天晚上，太阳下山以后，人们把所有生病的人带到耶稣那里，也带来所有身上有邪灵的人。

fa.L: و چون شام شد، هنگامی که آفتاب غروب کرد، همهٔ بیماران و دیوزدگان را نزد او می‌آوردند.
fa.B: هنگام غروب، پس از آن‌که آفتاب فرو نشست، مردم همهٔ بیماران و کسانی را که دیوها در اختیارشان داشتند نزد او آوردند.
fa.R: آن شب، پس از غروب آفتاب، مردم همهٔ بیماران و همهٔ کسانی را که دیو در آنان بود نزد عیسی آوردند.

ar.L: ولمّا صار المساء، إذ غربت الشمس، كانوا يقدّمون إليه جميع السقماء والمجانين.
ar.B: وعند المساء، بعد غروب الشمس، أخذ الناس يحضرون إليه كلّ المرضى والذين تسيطر عليهم الشياطين.
ar.R: وفي ذلك المساء، بعد أن غابت الشمس، أحضر الناس إلى يسوع كلّ المرضى، وكلّ من كانت فيهم أرواح شرّيرة.

pa.L: ਹੁਣ ਜਦੋਂ ਸ਼ਾਮ ਹੋਈ, ਜਦੋਂ ਸੂਰਜ ਡੁੱਬ ਗਿਆ, ਤਾਂ ਉਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਬਿਮਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਨ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੋਲ ਲਿਆ ਰਹੇ ਸਨ।
pa.B: ਜਦੋਂ ਸ਼ਾਮ ਪੈ ਗਈ ਅਤੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਛਿਪ ਗਿਆ, ਤਾਂ ਲੋਕ ਹਰ ਰੋਗੀ ਨੂੰ ਅਤੇ ਭੂਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਵੱਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਏ ਹਰ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੋਲ ਲਿਆਉਣ ਲੱਗੇ।
pa.R: ਉਸ ਸ਼ਾਮ, ਸੂਰਜ ਡੁੱਬਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, ਲੋਕ ਸਾਰੇ ਬਿਮਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਯਿਸੂ ਕੋਲ ਲੈ ਆਏ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਭੂਤ ਸਨ।

alignments.target_span: 悪霊に取りつかれた人

decisions.choice: when the sun set: the Sabbath ended at sunset
decisions.reason: The Sabbath of 1:21 ended at sunset. Then people could carry the sick without breaking the Sabbath rest.

decisions.choice: demon-possessed: under the control of demons
decisions.reason: Mark keeps the sick and the demon-possessed apart (1:34): illness is healed, demons are cast out.

decisions.choice: they were bringing: one after another
decisions.reason: The verb is continuous: people kept bringing the sick.

decisions.choice: "bị quỷ ám" (L, B); "bị quỷ nhập" (R)
decisions.reason: "quỷ" is the word for demon, as in John; "ám" (haunt, possess) is the usual verb, and Readable's "nhập" (enter) is plainer.

decisions.choice: "귀신 들린 사람" at every level; "귀신" for demon, through Mark
decisions.reason: "귀신" is the everyday Korean word for an evil spirit that possesses a person, as in John 10:20-21 in Korean; "악령" sounds technical.

decisions.choice: endemoniados (L); dominados por demonios (B); que tenían demonios (R)
decisions.reason: "Endemoniado" is the Spanish word for the Greek participle; Balanced and Readable say in plain words what it means (meaning decision m2), and use "demonio" for the noun, as in John 10:20.

decisions.choice: possédés par des démons (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Démoniaque" in French today is mostly an adjective for something wicked; "possédés par des démons" says plainly what the Greek word means (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: pepo (demons); waliopagawa na pepo (L), waliotawaliwa na pepo (B), waliokuwa na pepo (R)
decisions.reason: "Pepo" is the Swahili word for a demon, as in John 10:20-21; casting them out is "kutoa pepo" (L), "kufukuza pepo" (B) and making them come out (R), as in Mark 3:15. The unclean spirits of 1:23 are "pepo wachafu", the same word with "unclean" added, as in the Swahili of Matthew and Luke. "Mashetani" would confuse demons with Satan ("Shetani", 1:13). Used through Mark.

decisions.choice: 'бесноватых' (L); 'одержимых бесами' (B); 'в ком были бесы' (R)
decisions.reason: 'Бес' is the word for a demon in this translation. Literal keeps the one-word term; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as in Matthew 8:16.

decisions.choice: "kerasukan setan" (L); "dikuasai roh jahat" (B), "dirasuki roh jahat" (R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for demons: "setan" in lowercase at Literal, "roh jahat" at Balanced and Readable, for the whole of Mark.

decisions.choice: "被鬼附的" (L); "受邪灵控制的人" (B); "身上有邪灵的人" (R)
decisions.reason: The glossary has "鬼" at Literal and "邪灵" at Balanced and Readable, since "鬼" alone reads as "ghost"; the wording follows Matthew 8:16.

decisions.choice: "المجانين" (L), "الذين تسيطر عليهم الشياطين" (B), "من كانت فيهم أرواح شرّيرة" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek is one word, "the demonized" (m2). Literal uses "المجانين" in its old sense of those possessed by spirits; Balanced names the demons and Readable says "أرواح شرّيرة", as the glossary gives for demons at those levels.

source.text: καὶ ἦν ὅλη ἡ πόλις ἐπισυνηγμένη πρὸς τὴν θύραν.

records.literal_gloss: And was all the city gathered together at the door.

en.L: And the whole city was gathered together at the door.
en.B: The entire town had crowded together outside the door.
en.R: Almost everyone in the town crowded around the door of the house.

vi.L: Và cả thành đã tụ họp lại trước cửa.
vi.B: Cả thị trấn kéo đến tụ tập trước cửa.
vi.R: Hầu như mọi người trong thị trấn đều kéo đến, đứng chen chúc trước cửa nhà.

ko.L: 그리고 온 고을이 문 앞에 모여 있었다.
ko.B: 온 동네 사람들이 그 집 문 앞에 몰려들었다.
ko.R: 마을 사람들이 거의 다 그 집 문 앞으로 몰려왔다.

es.L: Y toda la ciudad estaba reunida a la puerta.
es.B: Todo el pueblo se había agolpado a la puerta.
es.R: Casi toda la gente del pueblo se juntó frente a la puerta de la casa.

fr.L: Et la ville entière était rassemblée à la porte.
fr.B: Toute la ville s’était rassemblée devant la porte.
fr.R: Presque tous les habitants de la ville se pressaient devant la porte de la maison.

sw.L: Na mji mzima ulikuwa umekusanyika pamoja mbele ya mlango.
sw.B: Watu wa mji wote walikuwa wamejazana nje ya mlango.
sw.R: Karibu watu wote wa mji ule walikusanyika kuzunguka mlango wa nyumba ile.

pt.L: E a cidade inteira estava reunida junto à porta.
pt.B: A cidade toda tinha se juntado diante da porta.
pt.R: Quase todo mundo da cidade se juntou em volta da porta da casa.

am.L: ከተማውም ሁሉ በደጁ ተሰብስቦ ነበር።
am.B: የከተማው ሕዝብ ሁሉ በደጁ ፊት ተሰብስቦ ነበር።
am.R: በከተማው ያሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ማለት ይቻላል በቤቱ በር ዙሪያ ተሰበሰቡ።

ru.L: И весь город собрался у двери.
ru.B: Весь город собрался у дверей.
ru.R: Почти весь город собрался у дверей дома.

hi.L: और सारा नगर द्वार पर इकट्ठा हो गया था।
hi.B: पूरा नगर दरवाज़े के बाहर जमा हो गया था।
hi.R: नगर के लगभग सब लोग घर के दरवाज़े के आसपास इकट्ठे हो गए।

uk.L: І все місто було зібране біля дверей.
uk.B: Усе містечко зібралося перед дверима.
uk.R: Майже все містечко зібралося біля дверей будинку.

ja.L: そして町全体が戸口に寄り集まっていた。
ja.B: 町中の人々が戸口の前に押し寄せていた。
ja.R: 町のほとんどの人が、その家の戸口の周りに集まって来ました。

id.L: Dan seluruh kota berkumpul di depan pintu.
id.B: Seluruh penduduk kota itu berkerumun di depan pintu.
id.R: Hampir semua orang di kota itu berkerumun di depan pintu rumah itu.

zh.L: 整座城都聚集在门口。
zh.B: 全镇的人都挤在门外。
zh.R: 镇上几乎所有的人都围在那房子的门口。

fa.L: و تمام شهر بر در گرد آمده بودند.
fa.B: همهٔ مردم شهر بیرون در جمع شده بودند.
fa.R: تقریباً همهٔ مردم شهر جلوی در آن خانه جمع شدند.

ar.L: وكانت المدينة كلّها قد اجتمعت عند الباب.
ar.B: واحتشد أهل البلدة كلّهم أمام الباب.
ar.R: وتجمّع أكثر أهل البلدة حول باب البيت.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰਾ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਬੂਹੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਇਕੱਠਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਸੀ।
pa.B: ਸਾਰਾ ਨਗਰ ਬੂਹੇ ਦੇ ਬਾਹਰ ਆ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਸੀ।
pa.R: ਨਗਰ ਦੇ ਲਗਭਗ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਘਰ ਦੇ ਬੂਹੇ ਦੁਆਲੇ ਭੀੜ ਲਾ ਕੇ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਸਨ।

decisions.choice: the whole city: a great crowd from the town
decisions.reason: "Whole" stresses how many came, as in 1:5.

decisions.choice: city: a town
decisions.reason: The word is used for any town with walls or a council. Capernaum was a lakeside town.

decisions.choice: town (B, R); city (L)
decisions.reason: Capernaum was small, so Balanced and Readable say "town". Readable says "almost everyone" to show the exaggeration.
Capernaum was a town (meaning decision); "도시" (city) would make it sound large and "성" (walled city) is old-fashioned. "고을" is the word used for a town in John 1:44 in Korean.

decisions.choice: la ville (every level)
decisions.reason: French "ville" is used of a town of any size, so it can stand at every level where English moves from "city" to "town" (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "ከተማ" (town, city) at every level
decisions.reason: Amharic "ከተማ" covers both a city and a town, so one word serves where the English Literal says "city" and Balanced and Readable say "town".

decisions.choice: "町" at every level
decisions.reason: Japanese "町" covers both a town and a city, and Capernaum was a small lakeside town (m2), so one word serves every level.

source.text: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις, καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλεν, καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν λαλεῖν τὰ δαιμόνια, ὅτι ᾔδεισαν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And he healed many badly having various diseases and demons many he cast out, and not he was allowing to speak the demons, because they knew him.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} healed many who were sick with various diseases, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cast out many demons; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was not allowing the demons to speak, because they knew {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: He cured many people who had diseases of every kind, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} threw out many demons. He did not permit the demons to say anything, since they knew {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Jesus healed many people who had all kinds of sicknesses. He forced many demons to leave people. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not let the demons talk, because they knew who {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành nhiều người đau ốm vì đủ thứ bệnh, và đuổi nhiều quỷ; và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cho các quỷ nói, vì chúng biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài chữa lành nhiều người mắc đủ loại bệnh tật, và đuổi nhiều quỷ ra. Ngài không cho các quỷ nói gì, vì chúng biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu chữa lành nhiều người mắc đủ thứ bệnh. Ngài buộc nhiều quỷ phải ra khỏi người ta. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cho các quỷ nói, vì chúng biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là ai.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 여러 가지 병으로 앓는 많은 사람들을 고치시고, 많은 귀신들을 쫓아내셨다. 그리고 귀신들이 말하는 것을 허락하지 않으셨다. 그들이 그분을 알았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 예수께서는 온갖 병에 걸린 많은 사람을 고쳐 주시고, 많은 귀신을 쫓아내셨다. 그러나 귀신들이 아무 말도 하지 못하게 하셨다. 귀신들은 그분을 알고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 온갖 병을 앓는 많은 사람을 고쳐 주셨다. 또 많은 귀신을 사람들에게서 쫓아내셨다. 그러나 귀신들이 말하지 못하게 하셨다. 귀신들은 예수께서 누구신지 알고 있었기 때문이다.

es.L: Y sanó a muchos que estaban enfermos de diversas enfermedades, y expulsó muchos demonios, y no dejaba hablar a los demonios, porque {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocían.
es.B: Curó a muchos que padecían enfermedades de toda clase y expulsó a muchos demonios. Pero no dejaba que los demonios dijeran nada, porque {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocían.
es.R: Jesús sanó a mucha gente que tenía toda clase de enfermedades. Obligó a muchos demonios a salir de la gente. Pero no dejaba hablar a los demonios, porque sabían quién era.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} guérit beaucoup de malades atteints de diverses maladies, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} chassa beaucoup de démons ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laissait pas les démons parler, parce qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissaient.
fr.B: Il guérit beaucoup de gens atteints de toutes sortes de maladies, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} chassa beaucoup de démons. Il ne permettait pas aux démons de parler, puisqu’ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissaient.
fr.R: Jésus a guéri beaucoup de gens qui avaient toutes sortes de maladies. Il a obligé beaucoup de démons à quitter les gens. Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laissait pas les démons parler, parce qu’ils savaient qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était.

sw.L: Naye aliwaponya wengi waliougua maradhi ya aina mbalimbali, na pepo wengi akawatoa; naye hakuwa akiwaruhusu pepo kuzungumza, kwa sababu walimjua.
sw.B: Aliwaponya watu wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa ya kila aina, akafukuza pepo wengi. Hakuwaruhusu pepo hao kusema lolote, kwa kuwa walimjua.
sw.R: Yesu aliwaponya watu wengi waliokuwa na magonjwa ya kila namna. Aliwafanya pepo wengi watoke ndani ya watu. Lakini hakuwaacha pepo hao waseme, kwa sababu walijua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni nani.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} curou muitos que estavam doentes de várias doenças e expulsou muitos demônios; e não deixava os demônios falarem, porque {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} conheciam.
pt.B: Ele curou muitas pessoas que tinham todo tipo de doença e expulsou muitos demônios. Não permitia que os demônios dissessem nada, porque {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} conheciam.
pt.R: Jesus curou muitas pessoas que tinham todo tipo de doença. Ele obrigou muitos demônios a sair das pessoas. Mas não deixava os demônios falarem, porque eles sabiam quem {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} era.

am.L: በልዩ ልዩ በሽታ የታመሙትንም ብዙዎችን ፈወሰ፤ ብዙ አጋንንትንም አወጣ፤ አጋንንቱም ያውቁት ስለ ነበር እንዲናገሩ አይፈቅድላቸውም ነበር።
am.B: በልዩ ልዩ በሽታ የተያዙ ብዙ ሰዎችን ፈወሰ፤ ብዙ አጋንንትንም አስወጣ። አጋንንቱ ያውቁት ስለ ነበር ምንም እንዲናገሩ አልፈቀደላቸውም።
am.R: ኢየሱስ ልዩ ልዩ በሽታ የነበረባቸውን ብዙ ሰዎች ፈወሰ። ብዙ አጋንንትንም ከሰዎች እንዲወጡ አስገደዳቸው። አጋንንቱ ግን ማን እንደ ሆነ ያውቁ ስለ ነበር እንዲናገሩ አልፈቀደላቸውም።

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} исцелил многих, страдавших разными болезнями, и изгнал многих бесов, и не позволял бесам говорить, потому что они знали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Он исцелил многих людей с самыми разными болезнями и выгнал много бесов. Бесам {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не давал говорить, потому что они знали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.R: Иисус исцелил много людей, у которых были разные болезни. Он заставил многих бесов выйти из людей. Но {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не позволял бесам говорить, потому что они знали, кто {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}.

hi.L: और उन्होंने बहुतों को, जो तरह-तरह की बीमारियों से बीमार थे, चंगा किया, और बहुत-सी दुष्टात्माओं को निकाला; और वे दुष्टात्माओं को बोलने नहीं देते थे, क्योंकि वे उन्हें जानती थीं।
hi.B: उन्होंने तरह-तरह के रोगों से पीड़ित बहुत-से लोगों को चंगा किया और बहुत-सी दुष्टात्माओं को निकाल दिया। वे दुष्टात्माओं को कुछ भी बोलने नहीं देते थे, क्योंकि दुष्टात्माएँ उन्हें जानती थीं।
hi.R: यीशु ने बहुत-से लोगों को चंगा किया जिन्हें तरह-तरह की बीमारियाँ थीं। उन्होंने बहुत-सी दुष्टात्माओं को लोगों में से निकल जाने पर मजबूर किया। पर वे दुष्टात्माओं को बोलने नहीं देते थे, क्योंकि वे जानती थीं कि यीशु कौन हैं।

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} уздоровив багатьох, що нездужали на різні хвороби, і багато бісів вигнав; і не дозволяв бісам говорити, бо вони знали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.
uk.B: Він зцілив багатьох людей, хворих на всілякі недуги, і вигнав багато бісів. Він не дозволяв бісам нічого казати, бо вони знали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.
uk.R: Ісус зцілив багато людей, які мали різні хвороби. Він змусив багатьох бісів вийти з людей. Але {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не дозволяв бісам говорити, бо вони знали, хто {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}.

ja.L: そしてイエスは、いろいろな病気にかかっている多くの人を癒やし、多くの悪霊を追い出された。そして悪霊たちが話すのを許されなかった。彼らがイエスを知っていたからである。
ja.B: イエスは、さまざまな病気に苦しむ多くの人を癒やし、多くの悪霊を追い出された。また、悪霊たちにものを言うことをお許しにならなかった。悪霊たちはイエスを知っていたからである。
ja.R: イエスは、いろいろな病気の人をたくさんいやされました。また、人々から多くの悪霊を追い出されました。でも、悪霊たちが話すことはお許しになりませんでした。悪霊たちは、イエスがだれなのかを知っていたからです。

id.L: Dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} menyembuhkan banyak orang yang sakit dengan berbagai penyakit, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} mengusir banyak setan; dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} tidak mengizinkan setan-setan itu berbicara, karena mereka mengenal-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.
id.B: Dia menyembuhkan banyak orang yang menderita bermacam-macam penyakit, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} mengusir banyak roh jahat. Dia tidak mengizinkan roh-roh jahat itu berkata apa-apa, karena mereka mengenal-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.
id.R: Yesus menyembuhkan banyak orang yang menderita bermacam-macam penyakit. Dia memaksa banyak roh jahat keluar dari orang-orang. Tetapi {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} tidak membiarkan roh-roh jahat itu berbicara, karena mereka tahu siapa {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}.

zh.L: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}医治了许多被各样疾病所苦的人，也赶出了许多鬼；而且{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}一直不让那些鬼说话，因为它们认得{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。
zh.B: {{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}治好了许多患各种疾病的人，又把许多邪灵赶了出去。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}不准邪灵开口，因为它们认识{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}。
zh.R: 耶稣治好了许多患各种疾病的人。{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}强迫许多邪灵离开人。但是{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}不让邪灵说话，因为它们知道{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}是谁。

fa.L: و بسیاری را که به بیماری‌های گوناگون مبتلا بودند شفا داد و دیوهای بسیاری را بیرون کرد؛ و نمی‌گذاشت دیوها سخن بگویند، زیرا او را می‌شناختند.
fa.B: او بسیاری را که به هر گونه بیماری دچار بودند شفا داد و دیوهای بسیاری را بیرون راند. نمی‌گذاشت دیوها چیزی بگویند، زیرا او را می‌شناختند.
fa.R: عیسی بسیاری را که بیماری‌های گوناگون داشتند شفا داد. او دیوهای بسیاری را وادار کرد که از مردم بیرون بروند. اما نمی‌گذاشت دیوها حرف بزنند، زیرا می‌دانستند او کیست.
